quests.name: 20 Years a Cook Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[An Old Friend] By accepting the mission Draccoon will lead you to Kazordoon to inform an old friend of his of his return.

In Kazordoon, go three floors up from depot (same floor where Sigurd is) and walk here where you'll find a light blue teleport. Step on it and you'll get teleported in a room with The Rest of Ratha. Walk and stand close to the skeleton until you get notified to head back to Draccoon to tell him about his friend's state. Say "mission" to update the quest.
Fun fact: The Rest of Ratha is a headless skeleton that was directly referenced by an old item: Skull of Ratha.
[Ghost Hunt] This task has a maximum duration of 600 seconds (10 minutes). This makes doing it alone hard to finish in time.
After informing Draccoon about Ratha, he believes a communication with the skeleton is still possible with the help of another friend who has tools that can "extract" Ratha.
Return to Kazordoon and this time you will access a lever room when stepping in the light blue teleport, leading to this quest's first task.

Your goal here is to position the Ghost Duster (Ratha) in a way that its beam hits Ratha. When hit by the beam Ratha will drop essences on the floor which you will collect with a Spirit Container (Ratha-Empty) Spirit Container (Ratha-Empty) and deposit in the bigger spirit container. You find the small container in a box near the Ghost Duster. All equipment needed (except the harp) are in the south-east corner of the room.

Note that the duster only beams when a player deals damage to it, so when Ratha is close to it, it is recommended that mages and paladins attack it from distance. It is also recommended to use spells that cause damage over time to it, like Inflict Wound, Ignite, Curse, Envenom, and Holy Flash. Additionally, since Ratha teleports a lot around the room, it is possible to play the Harp Harp in the middle of the room to lure it back there. Note that this only works 3 times.
Repeat the process of collection and depositing essences until your container reaches a sum of 50 and the task will be concluded.

[Almost a Seance] Report back to Draccoon and he says that he received the vial with Ratha's essences from the postman guild as well as a potion of spirit talking, a potion that allows humans to talk with human spirits. He asks you to grab the potion from his rack and drink it.
By using the rack, you accidentally drink Ratha's essences instead of the potion of spirit talking, and thus start "hearing" Ratha while he is able to read your mind.
Inform Draccoon of the current situation and he will let you know that this will get sorted, but he has other things to care for first.
Note: To get rid of Ratha's messages, use the rack a second time to "extract Ratha from your mind". This is possible once you received your reward.
[Revenge Best Served Fried!] This task has a maximum duration of 600 seconds (10 minutes).

Draccoon wants you to remove Nimmersatt's master cook, The Fryclops, from the picture. He says his friend and guildmate Bozo informed him the cyclops now resides on a small island north of Carlin where he tries to sink ships as a hobby.
Draccoon then sets an Ominous Trashcan Ominous Trashcan in the Ghostlands that is a secret passage to Fryclops' isle (here).

In the isle you'll have another lever task. In the first part of the task you need to lure Fryclops to beam the Locked Door in the north wall of the room. A total of four beams are needed to destroy the door.

Once the door is destroyed, walk out in the yard, get the Fryclops Axe Fryclops Axe from the chest then position Fryclops on the catapult. Once that happens, use the axe to cut the rope and launch the cyclops far away.

[In Charge] By defeating Fryclops, Draccoon and his mates now have access to his machine in his cellar but the machine needs to be refueled with infernal power crystals which you can steal from unsuspecting demons.
Head to Edron and near the Stone Circle, next to an abandoned tower, you will find an Ominous Trashcan Ominous Trashcan to the next task (here).
Note: Even though nothing in the room attacks you, you still receive damage reflection from Morshabaal and Ominous Pillar. Just ignore everything in the room.
This task has a limit of 200 seconds as you enter, then extends 10 seconds for each crystal. The timer is personal and you see the countdown on yourself.

In this task your goal is to steal 50 Immensely Powerful Crystal Immensely Powerful Crystal from the demons. During the task you are under the effect of Cheaty's spell thus disguised as something harmless and uninteresting.
Run to the northwest part of the room, use the crates with crystals, then run back to the entrace to store the crystal you got in the Crystal Collection Box.

When you pick up the crystal you will be "drunk with power" and will act as drunk until you have dropped off the crystal. Each time you drop off a crystal, your disguise is extended. Dwarven Ring have no effect.
Once you reach the goal of 50 crystals return to Venore and report to Draccoon.
[Charged Machine] This task has a maximum duration of 600 seconds (10 minutes).
Now that Draccoon can recharge the machine he'll tell you to go back to Ghostlands once again and use the left trashcan to Fryclops' cellar.

In this task you and the other players need to use the lever next to Draccoon to get things started, then use the ten other levers in the centre of the room to use the machine. To use the machine properly you need to use the lever that triggers green sparkles and makes a sound. It is recommend to assign a player for the top row and one for the bottom row to avoid various players misclicking the same lever at the same time.
During the process the machine will generate the following items, in order:
Worn Leather Boots Worn Leather Boots
Fire Sword Fire Sword
Crown Crown
Ferumbras' Hat Ferumbras' Hat
The Famous Sword of Fury The Famous Sword of Fury
The Broken Sword of Fury The Broken Sword of Fury
Using the machine makes it so you accidently break the Sword of Fury. Bring a new Spike Sword Spike Sword to Draccoon for a replacement.
[Bonelord Language] This task has a maximum duration of 540 seconds (9 minutes).

Draccoon paid a hefty sum of money to a mad scientist to crack the code of the Bonelord Language. Travel to Quirefang (here) and use the Ominous Trashcan Ominous Trashcan to meet the scientist in the next task and get the secret of the language for Draccoon.

required_items: Access to Meriana (completed "The Errand" mission of The Shattered Isles Quest);
Some Stone Skin Amulet Stone Skin Amulets (recommended);
rewards: Access to Bulltaur Lair and Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground, and the base Draccoon Herald Outfits.</br> Image:Outfit_Draccoon Herald_Male.gif Image:Outfit_Draccoon Herald_Female.gif

quests.name: 25 Years of Tibia Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] In Thais, go to the north-east wall tower and go down the stairs. You'll find a teleportation machine. Use it to enter the Time Travel Dungeon.

During this quest you'll go thorugh several areas which are replicas of existing areas of Tibia, in reverse order of implementation. You'll start at the replica of the Forest of Life, implemented in the Summer Update 2021 and finish at Thais, the very first city of Tibia.

The creatures are all "Memories" of the real creatures, and all have similar strength to each other. Most of them are weaker than the real creatures, with the exception of the memories of weak creatures such as Amazons and Dwarf Guards.

[Forest of Life, Lion Sanctum and Kilmaresh] After entering the dungeon, follow the path until you reach a Lion Statue. If you have the White Silk Flower on you, you'll be allowed to use the statue and proceed.

After crossing the wall, go north and pick up the Palette and Brushes Palette and Brushes from the Sarcophagus, here. Next to it you'll also find a Brass-Shod Chest containing a Half Empty Picture Album (Falcon Order) Half Empty Picture Album (Falcon Order). You'll need these items throughout the quest.

Finally, on the room to the east you'll find a Blank Paper Blank Paper in a Coffin, here. You'll find several in the dungeon and you'll need a total of 8 of these. All of the places you can get Blank Paper share a per-character cooldown of two minutes. In other words, there's no point running back and forth between two spots because it won't help you get Blank Papers more quickly.
Follow the dungeon until you reach a Portal at the end

[Secret Library, Feyrist, Halls of Hope and Krailos] On this floor you can start completing your picture album. Walk north from the entrance where you'll find a Falcon Banner on the wall. When near it, use your Palette and Brushes Palette and Brushes on an Blank Paper Blank Paper. You'll paint a Picture of a Falcon Banner Picture of a Falcon Banner. Use the Picture on the album and it will become a Half Empty Picture Album (Halls of Hope) (its sprite won't change).

Now, follow the dungeon towards the other side. Near the portal, you'll have to dig around the sand until you find a Tibia Coin (Item) Tibia Coin (Item). Once you have it you'll be able to pass through the portal. Note that the first time you pass through the portal it will "consume" the Tibia Coin, however if you wish you can dig one up every 10 minutes.
[Oramond, Roshamuul, Warzone 1, The Hive and Fiehonja] Once you get here you'll have several items to collect:
If you did not bring one, you'll need to loot a Bronze Gear Wheel Bronze Gear Wheel from the Golems.

Use the Valve on the ground here or here to take a Copper Valve. Copper Valve (Item) Only the brighter, Copper Valves Copper Valve can be picked up. Once taken it takes 5 minutes for a new valve to appear.
From a small pile of rubbish on the floor, pick up the Calibrated Indicator Gauge Calibrated Indicator Gauge.
North of the golems you'll find a chest. Take the Glass Tube Glass Tube from it.

Now, return all the way to the entrance as if you were returning to Thais. When you get to the Time Machine you will not be able to use it anymore because it's broken. Use the four items on the machine to fix it. You'll be allowed to leave the dungeon and return again as you wish.

Go back to the Oramond area. In the Roshamuul area you'll find another Blank Paper you should take. Then continue following the dungeon until you reach the Fiehonja area, where there's also a paper to the south. Go into the portal to the next area.
[Zao, Yalahar, Svargrond, Liberty Bay] When you reach this area, in the building where you arrive open a chest to pick up the Wind-Up Loco Wind-Up Loco, it's needed for the Gloothomotive mount.
On the next room to the south with Yalahari, click on the skull on the floor to take a Black Skull (Quest) Black Skull (Quest).
Moving on, find a nest with eggs north-west of the Svargrond area where you'll take a Flask with Paint Flask with Paint. Use it on the nearby baby seals to paint 3 of them.
Next, jump into the water and open the floating bottle to pick up another piece of Blank Paper.

You can now continue to the next area. Every time you enter the teleport to the next area, it consumes 5 soul points. You get the message "Venturing forth into Tibia's past only costs you a small part of your soul. Go for it!".

[Tiquanda, Ankrahmun and Venore] Before starting this part make sure you have 5 regular Blessings or 5 Blessing Charms, and you are Promoted. You will need to walk past the jungle and in the portal south of the desert
Around the Venore area, you'll get the remaining Skulls you need for the quest. The skulls are displayed on the map to the right and are the following:
Green Skull (Item) Green Skull (Item) North-east inside a barrel, here
Red Skull (Item) Red Skull (Item) South-east inside a dead human, here
Yellow Skull (Item) Yellow Skull (Item) Inside the small house north of the passage, here
White Skull (Item) White Skull (Item) Inside a coffin, here
Orange Skull (Item) Orange Skull (Item) Inside a skeleton near the portal, here
There are also 2 Blank Papers in this area as shown on the map. Once you have all the skulls, including the Black Skull from the previous areas, go into the portal.

[Edron, Ab'dendriel and Kazordoon] Once you reach the area, go to the small house south-east and pick another Blank Paper. Then, walk northwest of the Edron area, towards the Ab'dendriel area, then south until you reach the Kazordoon area. There look for a Barrel Barrel, use it and get a Commemorative Platinum Coin Commemorative Platinum Coin.
Continue to the last room, use the platinum coin on the coin slot west of the final door, then proceed to next portal.

[Thais] Here is the last floor. All you need to do, for now, is to walk north to the room resembling Frodo's food store and enter the Orange Magic ForcefieldMagic Forcefield (Orange) found here which will lead you to Calcanea (Retro) here. There you can get a Old Health Potion Old Health Potion in a Dead Human found here. You should once again use your Palette and Brushes Palette and Brushes on a Blank Paper Blank Paper while standing here to get last Picture of Calcanea Picture of Calcanea.

At this point you have full access to the dungeon and all there's left is the boss access by finish filling up your album. Considering you already have the previously mentioned Picture of a Falcon Banner Picture of a Falcon Banner and Picture of Calcanea Picture of Calcanea, now you have to get the following pictures:
Halls of Hope Picture Halls of Hope Picture (here)
Adventurers' Guild Picture Adventurers' Guild Picture (here)
Picture of the Colossus Picture of the Colossus (here)
Picture of the Carlin Bank Picture of the Carlin Bank (here)
Picture of Venore's Statue Picture of Venore's Statue (here)
Picture of an Elven House Picture of an Elven House (here)

required_items: 1x White Silk Flower White Silk Flower
1x Bronze Gear Wheel Bronze Gear Wheel
1x Copper Valve Copper Valve (Item) Obtain from the Underground Glooth Factory or during the quest.
rewards: First Achievement achievement and base Formal Dress Outfits Image:Outfit_Formal_Dress_Male.gif Image:Outfit_Formal_Dress_Female.gif

quests.name: A Father's Burden Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Mission] First of all, go to Edron and find the NPC Tereban. He is above the depot, at Mirabell's tavern (here). Ask him for a mission and accept it with yes.

You are asked to find rare components of items. These items are found in dungeons. You can do these missions at any time, in any order, and you don't have to report a completed mission before doing another. You will receive 2500 experience for each item you turn in. When you hand in the last of the items, you can finally receive the Old Cape as well as 8,000 additional experience and gold.
The items and the city they are closest to are:

[The Magic Bow - Sinew] Go to the Edron Wyvern Hill (here) and fight your way to the far east. On the north side there is a sealed door. Go in and up the ramp, kill Heoni (who is about as strong as a Wyvern) and use the dead Heoni in order to obtain Strong Sinew. You do not have to kill Heoni yourself, just use the corpse.
Strong Sinew
Bring it back to Tereban by saying strong sinew.

[The Magic Bow - Wood] Go to Svargrond and head west out of town, continue west over the mountain, down the stairs and continue west to the raider camp or if you have completed the Barbarian Test travel with Buddel to the raider camps. Proceed north across the thin sheet of ice to Bittermor, the northern glacial camp. In this camp, directly north of the entrance, is a sealed door (here). Go in it and open the box to receive the Exquisite Wood.
Exquisite Wood
Bring it back to Tereban by saying exquisite wood.

[The Magic Robe - Cloth] Go to the Isle of the Kings and descend to the 6th floor of the catacombs. Go north-west until the end and use a Pick in the shadow of a Stone Pillar (here). Go down the hole to the 7th floor and go west until you find the sealed door. Go in it and open the chest for the Spectral Cloth.
Spectral Cloth
Bring it back to Tereban by saying spectral cloth.

[The Magic Robe - Silk] Go to the Zao Wailing Widow Cave, the entrance to which can be found north-east of the central orc camp (here). From the first floor ramp, go south-west and open the Spider Webs with your melee weapon or Firebug. Go through the web opening and down the ramp at the end of the passage. Now go south-west and follow the cave south, then south-east before it turns north-east. You will need to open another set of Spider Webs with your weapon or firebug before continuing north-east in search of a ramp along the southern wall of the cave. You are now at the final floor. …
Exquisite Silk
Bring it back to Tereban by saying exquisite silk.

[The Magic Rod - Crystal] Go to Ankrahmun and exit the city from the north-eastern ramp. Follow the city's walls south to the south-eastern part of Darama. Dig for the Shadow Tomb (here), go in and down to the 5th floor. Go to the northern part of this floor (here) and find a sealed door. Go in and use the sarcophagus at the northern side of the room to obtain the Magic Crystal.
Magic Crystal
Bring it back to Tereban by saying magic crystal.

[The Magic Rod - Root] Go to Port Hope and head to Banuta. If you have a high enough Paw and Fur Society rank you can travel directly to Banuta via Lorek's ferry. When you reach Banuta, go down the southern-most staircase (here). You will face a lot of Apes here. Go north all the way (to here) and through the sealed door. Open the box to obtain the Mystic Root.
Mystic Root
Bring it back to Tereban by saying mystic root.

[The Magic Shield - Iron] Go to Kazordoon and find the Steamship. You can travel directly from Cormaya or Farmine, walk through the city's mine or take the Ore Wagons. When you reach the steamship, go up from the steamship twice to reach the main floor with Dwarves and Dwarf Soldiers. Go south-west and down the hole to a single Dwarf Guard. Kill the guard and open the sealed door to the west of the room. Open the box to find the Old Iron.
Old Iron
Bring it back to Tereban by saying old iron.

[The Magic Shield - Scale] Go to Thais and follow the dirt path north to Greenshore. When you cross the bridge to Greenshore, search for a hidden pitfall behind a tree a few steps north of the ramps (here). Down there are Orcs and Orc Spearmen. Kill them and go down again, but be mindful of the traps on the floor which may damage you. Follow the cave south and kill the various Orcs before going down again. Go south a bit and then west all the way to reach the Greenshore Dragon Lair. Go up and kill the Dragon who is accompanied by a Dragon Hatchling. Find a thin corridor on the western part of …
Flexible Dragon Scale
Bring it back to Tereban by saying flexible dragon scale.

required_items: Melee weapon or Firebug to break the Spiderwebs
Completed first mission of The New Frontier Quest
Completed first mission of The White Raven Monastery Quest
rewards: 28,000 exp, 8,000 gp, Old Cape

quests.name: A Piece of Cake

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
A Piece of Cake starts on February 21 and ends on February 26th.
[World] 25% faster health and mana regeneration for seven days
Experience bonus of 50% for premium players for seven days
[Individual] Cake Cabinet Kit or Cake Backpack or Cake Tapestry
Cake Conqueror and I Did My Part achievements
Strawberry Cupcake or Blueberry Cupcake or Lemon Cupcake

[First stage] When the World Quest starts, you will notice raids of Cake Golems in Thais, Carlin, Edron, Darashia or Liberty Bay. These raids happens once per hour starting at the Server Save until the requirements for the second stage are fulfilled. The first raid occurs at SS+1.

When the Cake Golems appear in the cities, a few of them needs to be killed in order to collect 200 Sweet and Sugary Substances. These substances should be delivered to the Baker NPCs who can be found near the Cake Extraction Machines. A copy of A Piece of Cake I (Book), which explains the first stage of the quest, can also be found near every machine. If you say mass to any baker, they will tell you how many sugary substances were delivered.
You also need to lure 200 Cake Golems to be extracted in the machines. If you say base to any baker, they will tell you how many Cake Golems that were lured already.
The extraction machine on Carlin is located near the magic shop of Rachel (here). The baker is Benny The Baker.
In Thais it is located near the southern entrance (here). The baker is Biff The Baker.
In Edron the machine is located near the Stonehome entrance (here). The baker is Brian The Baker.
In Darashia it is located to the north-west, near a Wasp Tower (here). The baker is Balduin The Baker.
And the machine in Liberty Bay is located to the north-east, near Bertram (here). The baker is Billy The Baker.
Every 10 minutes the server will check if all the sugary substances and base material has been delivered. If so, the bridge in south of Cormaya will be built and the second stage will start.
[Second stage] Go to the bridge in the southern end of Cormaya, here. You will find a massive cake and A Piece of Cake II (Book), which will explain the second stage of the quest.

Every 30 minutes after the bridge was built there will be an event where you have to eat cake. If all of the cake is eaten (except for the corners) the next layer will drop. if it isn't, the layer will reset and you will have to try again.

Before this part is started you should make sure you have a lot of hungry people (not regenerating) in Cormaya so when the 30 minutes begins they can rush to the cake and start eating it. Each character can take 4 bites initially, each bite fills you up for 4 minutes (to a total of 16). Waiting another 1 minute will give you another bite which will then make you completely full (19). It takes 19 minutes to become completely hungry again. in the 30 minutes you get to eat a floor a player can have a maximum of 12 bites. This means that there has to be at least 87 players eating the cake in …
If the whole layer has been eaten since the last reset the next layer will come down. Once all 4 layers are eaten the world quest is completed!
NOTE: If the server completes a layer in the 30 min time frame that layer will be saved and you'll continue future layers from that point (example: "One layer of the cake-tower has been eaten!"

On Titania came up with the idea to do it in true PvP-style. Since there were too few hungry characters they created noobchars that resident in Edron. These players were given money to travel to Cormaya and once a char was full, it was killed - making it hungry again. This way the cake was eaten in four turns straight [2 hours].

[Rewards] Once the whole cake has been eaten, NPC Brutus The Baker will appear here after the next Server Save. At this point it means your world has succeeded the event and for the next seven days you will benefit from 25% more health and mana regeneration and a experience bonus of 50% for premium players.

Say help to him, then he will ask you to step on the Cake Base at the island, and then visit one of the Cake Extraction Machines, repeating these two steps for each city until all extraction machines have been visited. For example: Cake Isle > Liberty Bay (here) > Cake Isle > Thais (here) > Cake Isle > Carlin (here) > Cake Isle > Darashia (here) > Cake Isle > Edron (here) > Cake Isle.

Note: You may begin the task of stepping on the cake base before speaking to Brutus. This means if your server completes the task of eating the entire cake and you wish to begin the task early you may do so and turn the task in once he has spawned the next server save.
Once you have visited all the extraction machines, return to Brutus The Baker and ask for your reward in order to choose one of the three cake items:
Cake CabinetCake Cabinet Kit
Cake Backpack Cake Backpack
Cake TapestryCake Tapestry
And one of the three cupcakes:
Blueberry CupcakeBlueberry Cupcake
Strawberry CupcakeStrawberry Cupcake
Lemon CupcakeLemon Cupcake

required_items: Dwarven Ring avoids drunkenness when you lure Cake Golems into the Cake Extraction Machines.
For the second stage a lot of hungry people will be needed.
rewards: Successful worlds get seven days of 25% more health and mana regeneration and an experience bonus of 50% for premium players. Achievements Cake Conqueror and I Did My Part. One reward item: a Cake Backpack, a Cake Cabinet Kit, or a Cake Tapestry. One of three Cupcakes: Blueberry Cupcake, Strawberry Cupcake or Lemon Cupcake.

quests.name: A Pirate's Death to Me

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
Event starts if Friday falls on the 18th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 22nd or 23rd of a month (unless there is a World Event active or about to be launched same day).

[Step 1] Seek out NPC Smaralda south-west of Thais (directly south of the Lighthouse here).Start a conversation, ask her for a "soul seeing" and join the captain's crew.You have now been given a certain soul mark.
There are 5 different Soul Marks a player can be assigned:
Arrow
Rock
Rope
Rune
Torch
If you forget which soul mark you have, just ask to Smaralda about "soul seeing" or step in the Glowing Switches inside Smaralda's house. Tell her "join" to obtain the Scum Bag.

Then proceed to catch 5 Spectral Scum with the Scum Bag given to you by Smaralda.They will raid the cities of Thais, Carlin, Ab'dendriel, and Liberty Bay every 2 hours starting at Server Save.If you lose your Scum Bag, you can ask Smaralda for a trade and buy another for 500 gp.

[Step 2] After catching 5 Spectral Scum with your Scum Bag ("Use" the bag on a pirate to catch it, you will get a message when it's full), return to Smaralda and tell her "join".Next you will need to find 3 players with the same soul mark as yourself.Then all 4 players need to use the Crystal Ball inside Smaralda's house and you will be teleported to another room.All 4 players must stand on the Glowing Switches and use the Lever to be teleported to the ship.
[Step 3] You have 2 minutes to go to your floor before the journey starts. Each journey lasts 5 minutes.
It's recommended that the fastest player go to the middle deck .
At start the ship has 40 points of health. The ship can lose health by:
15 points due to spirit bats attack. The ship took 15 damage due to marauding pirate bats!
10 points due to burnt down spirit flame: The ship took 10 damage due to a burnt down spirit flame!
4 points due to holes made by ghost rats: The ship took 4 damage due to spirit rat investation!
Random amount of points (but quite high) due to ship core losing all health points.

[Upper deck] Kill the bats by using the corresponding telescope.Do not kill the Soul Spark.Make sure the Soul Spark stays near the Ship Core. It can also be trapped near the Ship Core with Fire Walls and/or Fire Fields, this way the Soul Spark heals the Ship Core all the time and damage to the ship coming from the Ship Core will be avoided.

[Middle deck] Two minutes after your team entered the ship, a purple flame will appear at the western corner.Step on the wooden tile right of it and you will be charged with Fire, Energy, or Earth.Run to the corresponding shrine, use it and then run back to the purple flame and do the same thing over and over again untill the quest is either completed or failed.

Your task is to keep the purple flame burning, each time you succeed on using the correct shrine the purple flame gets new burning time.If you manage to take too long to get to the shrine the purple flame will change to a gray Poison Field for a while and your ship will take 10 points damage, but you can still proceed with the quest unless you get teleported out of it.

Beware stepping on the Spectral Vortex (Water Vortex) or the Iron Tiles (Rock (Grate)) while being charged.This will make you lose your charge and you will have to run back to the purple flame to obtain a new one, making you lose valuable time.The trick is to focus on not stepping on the wrong tiles rather than just rushing.

There also spawn Sloth Wraiths that may Paralyze, you can make them walk over a Spectral Vortex and they will disappear.Players with level below 60 should use Haste spells, Time Ring and speed-enhancing equipment (see: Speed Set).
Having Dwarven Ring is also recommended in case you step the wrong tiles.

A method to run in this place (that might be faster for some people) is to wait 70 seconds after enter the ship and put fire fields on every Spectral Vortex and Iron Tile, then use map marks to walk to the western purple flame and the shrines when needed. Something like this:

[Lower deck] On the lowest deck, Ghost Rats will spawn and chew holes on the ship.One player should use the Ghost Duster to kill the rats and the other fix the holes with a Emergency Kit (these items can be found at the northeast corner).
An alternative way to do this is having extra Emergency Kit and extra Ghost Duster (from previous attempts), so both players are able to do both tasks in case it is needed.

The rats run away from players, they can make you drunk but they don't see invisible players, so both players doing this wearing a Stealth Ring or use Invisible spell(every 2 minutes) will be the best option, Dwarven Ring can be used if the player doesn't have the Stealth Ring or Invisible spell.
There are some blind spots for holes, around the ship masts on this floor, if the players got extra time, they should try to repair them now and then, specially if they saw rats near masts recently.

[Rewards] If a world succeeds in 50 journeys, it will receive a 10% experience increase to some undead creatures for five days (see below). You can check how many times your world completed a journey by saying: "journeys" to Smaralda.
For each success: 20 Platinum Coins and a Pirates Surprise in a Pirate Bag
Ghost Sailor achievement, after the first success
Spectral Traveller achievement, after 5 successes
Nether Pirate achievement, after 10 successes
Scourge of Death achievement, after 50 successes
[Boosted Creatures] Acording to , the following creatures are affected by the experience bonus:
Ghoul
Skeleton
Demon Skeleton

required_items: Ghost Duster found in the ship's lowest deck
Emergency Kit found in the ship's lowest deck
Dwarven Ring recommended for the lowest deck or when catching Spectral Scum
Stealth Ring recommended for the lowest deck or when catching Spectral Scum
Speed boosters like Time Ring, Magical Torch, Haste spell and Speed Set
rewards: 4 Achievements (11 total points), 20 Platinum Coins and a Pirates Surprise in a Pirate Bag for each successful journey and 10% more Experience points for some undead creatures if the world reach 50 successful journeys.

quests.name: A Pirate's Tail Quest

[Overview] This quest has two separate mission-lines. The main mission revolve around helping Eustacio in the fight against Pirats. First you have to prove yourself to him by fighting Pirat Raids to gain access to Rascacoon. On the island, you must also gain the trust of the Rascoohan, the island inhabitants, to be able to reach The Wreckoning, the Pirats hideout, and fight their leaders.
Parallel to that, you can start a search for a Hidden Treasure lost by some Coryms, which will eventually require access to Rascacoon as well.
[Pirat Raids] Speak with Eustacio at the harbor in Venore (ground floor) – here.
Greet him with hi > mission > yes to offer your help against the Pirats.

To earn his trust, you must participate in multiple Pirat Raids across Tibia. Raid locations and types are random, but you can ask Eustacio about the current location to check if/where a raid is active.
Before heading out, ask him for an Orb Magical Water Orb and a Flintstone Flintstone, as both are required during the raids.
You need a total of 1,500 points to proceed.
[Locations] Raids may occur at any of the following locations:
East of Krailos, here
East of Thais, just east of the Bloodhall Guildhall, here
East of Darashia, here
North-west of Port Hope, here
North of Liberty Bay, here
[Raid Types] There are three different raid types, and any of them can occur at any of the listed locations. A new raid begins 30 minutes after the previous one ends.

[Spyrats] Spyrats spawn in the water near the shore. To reach them, use the Magical Water Orb Magical Water Orb on the water to create an underwater platform. Build a path of platforms toward the Spyrats, then defeat them.
Each Spyrat attacked grants 5 points.
You do not need to deal the most damage to receive points.
The raid ends after 60 Spyrats have been killed. You will then see: The pirats used the big wave to flee!
[Ship Attack] A large ship anchors near the shore. To repel the attack:
Use a Pick on nearby stones to obtain Ballistic Boulders Ballistic Boulder.
Load the boulders into the catapults.
Ignite them using the Greenish Flintstone Greenish Flintstone.
Pull the lever to fire.
There is a 5-second cooldown between shots, but you can reload and ignite immediately after firing.
Loading a Catapult: 2 points
Igniting a Boulder: 2 points
Firing a shot: 2 points
The raid ends after 50 shots are fired. You will then see: You fended off the attack! The ship is gone.
[Land Invasion] Pirats invade the surrounding area and must be defeated.
Each Pirat attacked grants 3 points.
You do not need to deal the most damage to receive points.
The raid ends after 100 Pirats have been killed. You will then see: You pushed them back! The pirats ran away.

[Rascacoon] After getting 1500 points with Eustacio (you can check by asking about your status), he will tell you about a secret passage that he believes leads to the Pirats hideout. The passage leads, in fact, to an island Rascacoon, which is also suffering with Pirats attacks. To reach this island, travel to Issavi and use the small shell north of the depot on the location shown below. Follow the path in this cave until you reach the surface of the island.

BE VERY CAREFUL as near the location north of the temple there is a pit-fall hole that (map)walking over will drop you into harms way. This hole leads to a group of Burning Gladiators, which can very easily kill a lvl 100 mage in no time.

[Isle Events] On the island, find Tik'hi Tak'he to the west. Offer him your help and he will ask you to assist the Rascacoon villagers in different tasks to grain his trust. Each task will give you a certain amount of points, which you can check with Tik'hi Tak'he by asking about trust points. You need 1200 trust points to be able to advance to the Tentugly fight.

Note: After visiting the island for the first time and talking to Tik'hi Tak'he you'll gain access to a shortcut between Venore and Rascacoon. To travel to the island, ask Eustacio about shortcut. To return, simply use the small boat on the deck where you arrive from Venore.
[Memory Test] Find the large room inside the mountain at the center of the island. A few seconds after entering the room it will be locked and the test will start.

At the center, a certain pattern of Pieces of Shells, Spiral Shells and Starfishes will appear. Your goal is to memorize them. Once this pattern disappears, several patterns of the same objects will appear around the center. You have to quickly find the pattern previously displayed and stay near it waiting for the round to end. The area corresponding to a pattern is delimited by the debris on the floor - you don't have to stay exactly on top of it.

A good strategy is to focus only on two of the three types of objects and their positions. For instance, there will always be a diagonal with 3 Starfishes or Spiral Shells. If you memorize that part and the remaining 2-objects diagonal, you'll end up with a unique pattern.

rewards: Krakoloss mount, Snowbash, Mossmasher, Sandscourge, Bladespark or Moonhunter Familiar (depending on the vocation) and its respective figurine, basic Rascoohan Outfits and the achievements Pied Piper and Release the Kraken.

quests.name: Adventures of Galthen Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Kesar the Younger] Go to Bounac and talk to Kesar the Younger.
Remember he only appears in the throne room when it's day in Tibia.
Ask him about Yselda. He'll tell you to look for the help of a seer.
[Lesh the Seer] Find Lesh the Seer in Bounac, here. Ask him about Yselda.
[Yselda's Curse] Go to Edron's Magic Academy and talk to Spectulus, again, ask about Yselda and say yes. He will tell you about Yselda's Curse and instruct you to follow Galthen's steps in Bounac.
[Lost Satchel] On the southern part of Bounac, walk west to a house where you'll find An Idol, here. Use the ritual notes on the floor in front of it to receive a message:
Staring at the writing you begin to decipher a letter. Then another and another. The symbols seem to wriggle and move: VBOX

Greet An Idol saying VBOX ('Death' in Jekhr) and you'll be teleported to a small cave. Inside it, just walk south until you find a dead tree and use it to obtain Galthen's Satchel Galthen's Satchel with an Artefact Box Artefact Box and a Parchment Parchment with the text shown to the right. You'll be automatically teleported out after some seconds.
Note: You can obtain new Galthen's Satchels Galthen's Satchel from the dead tree every 30 days.
[Ritual Words] To the north-east of An Idol, find Innkeeper Alphonse and ask him about Galthen and say yes to all his questions. You'll receive Ritual Notes Ritual Notes.
[Bounacean Lion] Return to Kesar and report your progress using the keyword Yselda.

You'll now have access to the Bounacean Lion, a place infested with Crypt Warrior. Go past the gate here to enter the dungeon. Go down the stairs, then south-west and down again. Go around the cave to reach the Sulphur Pool shown to the right, where you'll be teleported.
[Trees of Life] You're now in the Forest of Life. Find the Soup Kettle on the lowest floor all the way to the south-east, here. You'll need the following ingredients to prepare a soup:
20 Carnisylvan Fingers Carnisylvan Finger
10 Carnisylvan Barks Carnisylvan Bark
2 Human Teeth Human Teeth
Use all of them on the Kettle and then use the Kettle.

[Megasylvan Yselda] You'll be able to fight Megasylvan Yselda now. From the Kettle, go to the big room nearby and levitate up the ramp. Go south and walk near the trees to be teleported to a small room. You can fight Yselda with a team of up to 5 players. To make her vulnerable, say the words DEMIHBOULDR, SOMMBHA and WITHER in the NPC or Local Chat.

There are two possible ends to this fight. If you simply kill Yselda and let any of her Megasylvan Saplings die (there's four in total, one in each corner), you'll still be able to complete part of the quest. To go even further, however, you need to keep her four Megasylvan Saplings alive the entire fight.

The Saplings can be healed by players. The recommended strategy is to have a full team of 5 players with as many mages as possible. All players should have at least 100 Ultimate Healing Runes each. The Saplings constantly take 1000 damage during most of the fight, so they must be healed non-stop. Organize your team so the best healing power (mages) is focused on the south saplings, while others take turns between attacking and healing the northern saplings. Nevertheless, it's important that all players attack Yselda a few turns so they also get participation and loot.

Either way, after the fight say hi to Yselda in NPC form. The dialog will vary depending on the method you used to defeat her. You will receive the achievement Woodcarver. Leave the boss room through the (somewhat hidden) teleport to the south.
From now on, you can use a shortcut between the Forest and the Surface. The shortcut is located one floor up the exit of Yselda's lair, here.

Return to the surface and report your findings to Kesar the Younger to receive the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfit. If you have defeated Megasylvan Yselda while protecting her Saplings, you'll also receive a Violet Tulip Violet Tulip and the permission to talk to John (Bounac), which will give you the first addon of the outfit.

[Discovering Iksupan] Galthen has also explored an ancient lost city called Iksupan. To follow his steps, start by going to Tiquanda and walking close to the Writ at the ruins on the location shown on the map. You'll get the message "A sign reads: 'Sealed by the Inquisition at official behest of Chaplain Sandomo'" and a quest log update.

[The Key Intihuatac] The writ will lead you to Sandomo, an NPC in Roshamuul at The Inquisition's camp, here. Ask him about the door, and then follow the conversation by saying yes, grandfather, key, and diary. You'll receive a Piece of an Ancient Disc Piece of an Ancient Disc and a Crumbled Diary Page Crumbled Diary Page. Use the diary to add the locations of the two other Disc pieces to your map (You add the specific locations of the last known whereabouts of each piece from the diary to your map.).

The second piece is at Folda. At the island, go down the dungeon then all the way east to the location shown on the map. There, use a Pick or equivalent between the two ornamented tiles covered in debris and go down. Open the Pile of Bones to get a Fragment of an Ancient Disc Fragment of an Ancient Disc.

The final piece of the key is at Oramond. For this part, make sure you have the 5 Nails Nail with you. Go to the north-eastern Minotaur camp, then up the ramp at the center of the camp (here), up another floor, then south, and down twice, until you arrive here. Then, do the following:
Use the Crate to get Wet Boards Wet Boards.

Use the Wet Boards, while having the 5 Nails in your inventory, to create a raft. Note that you will not get any new item. With a few nails you manage to build a fragile little raft. This could take you to the smaller cliffs near the shore..
Use the Sturdy Bollard Sturdy Bollard south of you to travel to a small island nearby. You gently push the fragile makeshift raft into the water and make your way to a small cliff over yonder.
Use the Dragon Skeleton to receive a Part of an Ancient Disc Part of an Ancient Disc.
Finally, with all three pieces gathered, combine any two to craft The Key Intihuatac The Key Intihuatac.
[Replacement Key] Engage in a conversation with Sandomo by using the keyword Lost; he'll then assist you by replacing the lost Piece of an Ancient Disc.
Collect the Fragment of an Ancient Disc from the Pile of Bones found here.
Collect Part of an Ancient Disc from the Dragon Skeleton found here.
Finally, with all three pieces gathered, combine any two to craft The Key Intihuatac.

[Ahau] Now you will have access to Iksupan. Go back to the ruins in Tiquanda where you first started and use the Key on the inscriptions to enter the secret City of Gold. Once inside, you can go straight to the fight against their leader, Ahau. To do so, find your way to the third floor and then go all the way north. You'll find an area with lava and some stones on which you can walk on, until you reach a room with two blue flames. The north flame leads to the room with a lever, where you can start the fight with a team of up to 5 players.

Note: On the third floor of Iksupan there are some walkable lava tiles that deal damage proportional to the character's max health. Avoid map-clicking in this area and pay attention to your surroundings.

The fight against Ahau is relatively simple. Initially, you will find him along with two Cursed Apes. Start killing the boss at the middle of the room. It can be trapped by the throne. When it's about to die, it will heal to full health, explode dealing 500 Earth Damage and spawn another Cursed Ape. Furthermore, walkable lava streams on the left and right side of the rooms will appear, which is why you should stand at the center.

quests.name: Against the Spider Cult Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Go to Daniel Steelsoul and ask him for a mission (and accept it with yes). Your mission is to infiltrate the Edron Orc Cave and destroy 4 Spider Eggs.
In order to reach the Edron Orc Cave, go to the Edron Flats, which is just south of the Edron Castle, and find a Sewer Grate. Follow the sewer to the surface on the other side.

On the surface you will face Poison Spiders, Orcs, Orc Spearmen and a few Orc Warriors. Go south and find the entrance to the Edron Orc Cave (here). Check your minimap if you can't find it; it is concealed beneath a mountain.

On the first floor of the cave you will face the same monsters but with more Orc Warriors. When you enter, your path may be blocked by a rock. In this case, use the Lever to remove the rock. Fight your way to the south end of the floor and go down the hole.

On the next floor you will face the same monsters and maybe 1-2 lured Orc Berserkers. Go to the west until you find a hole. Instead of going down the hole, go north and then east in the first room. Go down the hole in this room.

As soon as you drop down the hole you will be surrounded by several Orc Shamans and their summons. Clear the room and head west, turning north when you can and follow the path north across Black Marble Floor. Drop down the hole.
Tip: use area attack runes like Great Fireball to clear the Orc Shamans and their summons.

You will be greeted by many Poison Spiders, Orc Shamans and even Orc Leaders. Go north and you will find a large pit with Giant Spider in it. Go down the ramp on the north-east side of the pit to enter, and kill the Giant Spider. Now use a melee weapon or a Firebug on the Spider Webs on the wall to destroy them and open a path to the Spider Eggs. Use the Spider Eggs to destroy them. When you destroy them, a Giant Spider will spawn a fair distance behind you. Kill the giant spider and proceed to destroy the other spider eggs. Destroy all 4 eggs and your mission is done. If you are not alone, …
You can exit the cave now, or you can do the other quests that are in the same cave. These quests are:
Dark Armor Quest
Barbarian Axe Quest
Berserker Treasure Quest
Poison Daggers Quest
Shaman Treasure Quest
When done, talk to Daniel Steelsoul about your mission and he will reward you.

required_items: A melee weapon to destroy the spider webs
rewards: Terra Amulet

quests.name: Alawar's Vault Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Equipment] Travel money (at least 20gp)
Pick or equivalent
One Destroy Field Rune if you take the short path

Key 4502 (if already received, or for short path (only for full rewards))
[Foreword] This quest has two parts: the long path is though Folda and the short path is through Senja.
The short path will grant you the minor rewards: 3 White Pearls and a Broadsword. If you have Key 4502 in advance, you can also receive: Dark Helmet, 4 Throwing Knives, Blank Rune, 33gp and Key 4502.
The long path grants you all rewards, including the key 4503. This does not require Key 4502 but if you have already received it, you should bring it (or you may be trapped).
[Short Path (Senja)] Go to Senja via the raft north of Carlin (20gp, ferry here).
Enter the Senja Castle cellar (here).
Cross the fields to the far west and find a lever beneath fire. Use a Destroy Field rune to reveal a lever.
Pull the lever and it will vanish, the magic walls to the north will also have disappeared.
Enter the Magic Forcefield to enter Alawar's Vault. Beware Minotaurs and a Minotaur Mage - unless the door is locked they will be able to reach you.
Open the 2 chests by the teleporter to receive your reward.
Go back through the teleporter to appear on the top of the castle. Alternatively if you brought key 4502, follow the long path (below) backwards for the rest of the rewards.
[Long Path (Folda)] Go to Folda via the ferry north of Carlin (20gp).
Enter Folda caves (here).
Follow the map above, or:
From the start of the cave, follow south-west until you come to a room with Minotaurs. Where south-west is not an option, follow south-east.
To the west, get Key 4503 from a chest in the western room.
Backtrack and find the protected area. Enter with Key 4503 and follow to the fire fields.
Use pick on the fire field against the wall, between stone piles
Go down the hole. Note: you cannot return here! You'll fall two levels down, with the second level being 1 sqm with only a hole. The only way to return is to complete the quest.

rewards: 3 White Pearls, Broadsword, Dark Helmet, 4 Throwing Knives, Blank Rune, 33gp, Key 4501, Key 4502, Key 4503.

quests.name: An Interest In Botany Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Before even attempting it, please note that this mission is not required to unlock the potion store. The potion store will be unlocked by completing The New Frontier Quest only.

Visit Rabaz in Farmine and ask him for a mission. He needs you to collect samples from rare plant specimen in Zao. Go to the storage room to the west and receive the Botany Almanach. Make sure you have the Botany Almanach in your inventory before you continue.

Leave Farmine to the Zao Steppes. Find the small north-western Lancer Beetle Cave and in it, the Giant Dreadcoil. It's about half way through the cave, here. When you find it, use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample. The samples do not exist as an item for you to confirm, so watch for the orange text that appears above your character.
Now you must find the second plant, a Giant Verminous. Go to the Zao Wailing Widow Cave, located slightly east of the Zao Orc Land (here).

Inside it, go north-east to find Spider Webs. Use your Fire Bug or a melee weapon on the spider webs to cut through them. Now go north and follow the path north-west and then north-east to find a large pit. On the edge there is a Giant Verminous. Use your Obsidian Knife on this plant and exit the cave. Note that there is a Giant Dreadcoil very close to the giant verminous. You cannot use this dreadcoil.
Now go back to Rabaz and turn in your mission to claim your Sedge Hat.

required_items: A Fire Bug or a Melee Weapon able to cut through Spider Webs.
rewards: 1,000 gp, Sedge Hat, 3000 exp.

quests.name: An Uneasy Alliance Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Mission 1 - The Wrath of the Kahn] Go to the central Orc camp in the center of Zao Steppes, and find the minotaur guard leader, Curos, in the north-east section of the camp. Curos will give you the mission to infiltrate the north-western Zao Orc Land and kill a rebel, the Renegade Orc.

Go to the north-western part of the Zao Steppe to reach the Zao Orc Land. Follow the path through the mountain to reach the last ramp (here) and go up. Along the east side of the mountain, look for a mountain to levitate up. It is concealed below the floor above, but if you hug the eastern side of the mountain you will see it. Levitate up and follow the mountain behind a bamboo fortress. Use your melee weapon on the damaged part of the wall until it breaks. Walk through and go downstairs. Go south-west and find the next ramp. Go down and then south-east to find a sealed door. Find the …

While you are here, it is recommended to get the Tome of Knowledge on the floor below. Go north from the ramp to find the entrance to the underground. From the ramp below, go north and west at the first chance you get to reach the room with the tome (here). You should only fight Orc Leaders, Orc Berserkers and smaller Orcs at the ramp and a lone Orc Warlord where the chest is. Get the Tome of Knowledge and leave.
Now report back to Curos. You will receive no reward from Curos for this mission but you have proven yourself worthy to the orcs.
[Mission 2 - The Maw of the Dragon] Note: to save time, it is recommended to do this alongside The New Frontier Quest, Mission 07: Messengers Of Peace.

Ask Curos for a further mission. He will instruct you to find the entrance to the underground lizard base and destroy a magical scrying device. Go north through the small slits in the mountain and find the only rope hole on the surface within the Dragonblaze Peaks (here). Rope up twice but beware that Dragon Lords may shoot you from other mountains. Go south-east and follow the mountain to the other side. Go down the ramp and north-west to find a Large Hole. Open the hole and drop down. From here on you will face strong High Class Lizards. Open the hole and go down to 1 Lizard Legionnaire. …

You are now in the basement of the tower. You must ascend to the top of the tower and break the Scrying Ball. The tower is very small and has little room to run. Each floor has the following monsters:
Floor
Creatures
1 Lizard Legionnaire
2 Lizard High Guards
1 Lizard Legionnaire, 1 Lizard High Guard
None
1 Lizard High Guard
1 Lizard Dragon Priest
1 Lizard Legionnaire, 1 Lizard High Guard
2 Lizard High Guards
When you reach the peak of the tower, use the Scrying Ball to destroy it. While here, you might want to open the chest next to it for a Tome of Knowledge.
If you wish, you may continue further in the underground dungeon for The New Frontier Quest mission, or you can leave the way you came. Either way, report to Curos to receive a Tome of Knowledge.

[Curos Daily Tasks] After completing Curos' 2 missions, you may request additional tasks for him. These are simple tasks that can be completed once per 20 hours. The 20 hour counter starts counting when you turn in your task. He will give out a task at random, and will reward you with experience and gold.

[Task 1 - Milk Delivery] Curos may ask for a Bucket of Milk. Buy a Bucket from any equipment shopkeeper and Milk from a specialist food store. Use the milk on the bucket to change the containers. Bring the bucket of milk back to Curos.
Reward: 800 experience, 650 gp and The Milkman achievement.

[Task 2 - To Feed a Beast] Curos sends you to retrieve a Crocodile Steak from a Killer Caiman. Travel to Muggy Plains and kill a Killer Caiman. Then use an Obsidian Knife to obtain a Crocodile Steak. You might have to kill a few Killer Caimans before you get a steak. Report back to Curos with the Crocodile Steak to complete the task.
Reward: 1800 experience and 2250 gp.
[Task 3 - Honour The Dead] Curos sends you to meditate on the Master Grave. You must stand on the grave on the northern side of the Dragonblaze Peaks (here) to complete the task.
Reward: 1100 experience and 1000 gp.

[Task 4 - Foul Spirits] Curos sends you to appease a tree spirit in an infested grove to the east by using a Wooden Flute. You should stand on the sqm in front of the tree spirit (with blood spot - here) when using the flute. There's a chance of failing. If you fail, 2 Haunted Treelings or 2 Carniphilas will spawn. Kill the spawned creatures and wait for the tree spirit to calm down (it has to return to its initial form), then try playing the flute again. Sometimes you will be Cursed for 20 turns (300 total damage).
You will receive a red message once you have appeased the tree spirit. Report back to Curos to turn in the task.
Reward: 1400 experience and 750 gp.

required_items: A Melee weapon, to break a wall.
Completed 6 missions of The New Frontier Quest
A Bucket of Milk (Task 1 - Milk Delivery)
An Obsidian Knife or Crocodile Steak (Task 2 - To Feed a Beast)
rewards: 2x Tome of Knowledge, experience and gold coins

quests.name: Annual Autumn Vintage

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
Begins at October 1 to the 8th and again from October 17th to 24th

[Method] Begin by traveling to Thais and talk with Emilie just west of the north gate, here. Ask her about a mission. You need at least 3 bunches of winterberries on you. If you agree, she will send you to the Winterberry cellar, here. There you can talk to Gruffy who can inform you more about the event.

This World Quest has several repeatable stages made of the below phases. You may see orange messages informing you of what you have to do in each phase. Once all phases are complete then you begin the next stage or the event is successful.

[Phase 1] First you must bring 10 Bunches of Winterberries to the cellar. Go to the north end of the cellar and use a Bunch of Winterberries on one of the Moulds. When you use it, you will see the following orange message: "Squish!" After you have squished enough bunches you will see the following message: "You already delivered all of your winterberries for today." A total of 100 winterberries have to be delivered to proceed to the next stage.

[Phase 2] Next you need to tread the Winterberries in the vat by walking over them. As you walk on each square they will become smoother. After a certain amount of time that a square is not walked upon the berries will regress to a prior smoothness and will need to be walked upon again. Therefore is it necessary to have multiple people involved to keep up.
[Phase 3] Phase 2 may be interrupted with three other needs:
You will need to add sugar. Go to the east side of the vat where you can see an area of sugar. Right-click and use the sugar then use it on the vat of Winterberries.
You will need to add water. Go to the west side of the vat where you can see the fountains, use a bucket on the fountains then use the bucket on the vat of Winterberries.
Berrypests appear in the vat and must be killed before they eat the Winterberries.
After these phases more berries may be needed and an orange message informs you to get more berries, then you must again follow phases 1-3.
It is not certain how many times the phases will repeat, but eventually a message will appear saying the event is finished.

There is a "tub of berries" at the north end of the cellar. The berries sprite reflects the stage you are in, so by the end of the final stage the berries in the tub should look like the last stage of Pressed Winterberries:
To leave the Winterberry Cellar, tell NPC Gruffy "Hi, Thais, Yes".
NOTE: The event will be successful as soon as a total of 40 loads (4000 Bunches of Winterberries) are stomped.
[Problems] There were a few known issues with this quest that were fixed as of the 5 October 2011 server save.
Sugar kept being added but the system did not recognize that there was enough.
24 hours after any given player entered the cellar and the event was successful, if any players were still in the cellar, they would be teleported back to Emilie.
[Rewards] If the world finishes the quest, Health and Mana Potion's effect will be enhanced by 33% for 7 days.
After contributing in the event over 3 years (at least one Bunch of Winterberries for one of the events each year) you will receive the achievement Berry Picker.

rewards: If the world finishes the quest, Health and Mana Potions' effects will be enhanced by 33% for 7 days; achievement Berry Picker.

The entrance is located east of the mountain pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun (here), in a little grotto. There is a crack in the surface. Place a Scimitar on this tile before pouring Water on the tile 2 steps to the right of it. A gate appears.

[Method] Note: It's recommended to start The Lost Brother Quest by accepting the mission from its NPC before doing the Asura Palace Quest, to save time. This way you can complete both quests at the same time.
Go to the Asura Palace in Tiquanda, here. Here you will encounter many Dawnfire Asuri, Midnight Asuri, Frost Flower Asuri and Hellspawns, so be careful.

On the very top floor there is a Sealed Door leading to the room of The Flaming Orchid. When trying to open it, you will see the following message: You see the images of liches, fire and energy elementals, hydras and destroyers over the doorframe. They're dark and faint. In order to be able to access this room, you will first have to kill these five sets of creatures that can only be reached through entrances hidden throughout the tower. This has to be done individually, so keep this in mind if you plan on going with a team. However (and similar to how the Nightmare Teddy Quest works), others …
To reach the three Hydras, go to the little patch of green on the ground floor and fall into the Pitfall here. Kill them and go up again.
To reach the two Liches, go to the westernmost part of the ground floor and step on Some Cracks (Hole) here. Kill them and go up again.
To reach the two Destroyers, fall through some cracks to the southwest of the green patch on the third floor, here. Kill them and go up again.
To reach the two Greater Fire Elementals, fall through some cracks in the northeasternmost part of the fourth floor, here. Kill them and go up again.
To reach the two Greater Energy Elementals, go to the northeasternmost part of the first floor and then fall through some cracks, here. Kill them and go up again.

You should now be able to enter the Sealed Door and kill The Flaming Orchid. If you have previously completed The Lost Brother Quest you will receive the achievement Lost Palace Raider after killing her.

In addition, you can find a chest containing three Small Sapphires on the highest floor of the western part of the tower, and a Sarcophagus (Quest) containing three Small Rubies on the highest floor of the eastern part of the tower.
Actually the bosses are three: The Moonlight Aster, The Flaming Orchid and The Winter Bloom. In order to reach every one of them you have to kill specific monsters hiding all over the palace.
The Moonlight Aster (level +5): kill 2 Vicious Liches and 2 Vile Destroyers
The Flaming Orchid (level +5): kill 3 Cave Hydras and 2 Greater Fire Elementals
The Winter Bloom (level -1): kill 1 Solitary Frost Dragon and 2 Greater Energy Elementals

The easiest and fastest way to kill all the monsters and bosses is to start at the level -1. We kill 2 liches and 1 frost dragon, then we go up and go down a hole to kill 3 hydras. Go back and go up (+1) and to the right, down the hole to kill 2 energy elementals. Go back and go up twice (+3) and to the left down the hole to kill 2 destroyers. Go back and go up (+4) and to the right down the hole to kill 2 fire elementals. Go back and go up (+5) where you have 2 boss rooms of The Moonlight Aster (left one) and The Flaming Orchid (right one). Now go all the way down to the beginning (hole with …
If you want to safe some time the next time, after killing The Winter Bloom, kill the Frost Dragon, the Liches, Hydras and Massive Energy Elementals.
Then leave the Palace. The kills will still be valid the next time you return.
So next time you can start by going upstairs, kill destroyers and Fire Elementals, before the 2 Rooftop Bosses, then run down to the Basement Boss and repeat.

rewards: 3 Small Rubies, 3 Small Sapphires, loot of The Flaming Orchid, achievement Lost Palace Raider (if the further requirements are met).

[Method] A new steamship travels between Kazordoon and Thais, but the path is flooded at Sunken Mines, near Kazordoon, here. Special pumps have been brought in to drain the water, but they need coal to operate. Apparently the remains of a sunken dynasty of unknown age is covered under the water and can be accessed when there is enough coal to drain the area.

Bring 202 nuggets of coal to Dronk and use them on any of the three Water Pumps down the mines. Once enough coal have been used, the pumps will start working by themselves, which means the mines will be opened at the next server save.

Every day that the dungeon is open a certain number of Deepling Scouts must be killed, otherwise they will flood the whole dungeon again so you need to drain all the water anew if you want to gain access to the hunting ground and the steamship link. if coal should be handed in

if enough coal is brought
Guide X: The mine tunnels under Kazordoon are currently flooded, but enough coal has been delivered to keep the waterpumps running. The tunnels should be dry soon.
Or, if the mines are open ...
... and enough deepling scouts have been killed in the mine today;

... and after 5 days, if not enough deeplings have been killed, the mines will become flooded (inaccessible) again.

quests.name: Bank Robbery Mini World Change

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Method] Occasionally, thieves will rob a bank in Tibia, prompting the bankers in Ab'Dendriel, Carlin, Thais, or Venore to request adventurers for help. When the event begins, the Towncryer will announce the robbery, and the Adventurer’s Board in the Adventurers' Guild will also mention it.

As players learn a bank has been robbed, they can immediately check which of the four cities have been affected, then right after look for thief. Once you find and defeat the thief, retrieve the Bag With Stolen Gold Bag With Stolen Gold and return to the corresponding banker to give them the money back.
Note that players may loot more than one bag during Double Loot Events or when using the Wealth Duplex Wealth Duplex potion.

The bag return must be done before the next Server Save, otherwise the event is terminated and the bag disappears from your inventory. Additionally, the bank services in the affected city will be unavailable until the bag is returned.

It is unknown how often this event can happen or what could affect its occurrence, however it is known that the event has a chance to happen hourly, based on the Server Boot time. If the robbery has not yet happened or the gold has already been returned, the Towncryer and Adventurer’s Board will not mention the event.
Returning the stolen goods rewards the Honest Finder achievement and 10 Platinum Coins. By returning five bags, players earn the achievement Goldhunter.

In case two or more bags were looted during an event, different players can return the bags to the banker if they return them at the same time. That means players must sync their dialogue with the NPC and ideally time the messages. By doing so the achievement progress for all involved players will advance by one.

rewards: Achievements Honest Finder and Goldhunter, 10 Platinum Coins.

quests.name: Barbarian Arena Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Introduction] In the north part of Svargrond there is an arena which you can fight in. Halvar will permit you access if you pay a fee first. The fees are 1,000 gp (Greenhorn), 5,000 gp (Scrapper), and 10,000 gp (Warlord). There is no level requirement but you must have completed any difficulties lower than your choice.

When you have paid, you can enter the sealed door by Halvar. At the end of the path there are 3 Magic Forcefields. Each of these will take you to the first arena and the first boss that you have agreed to battle will spawn immediately upon your arrival.

Each difficulty has 10 arena challenges. Each challenge has a time limit of 10 minutes. If you are in a room for longer than 10 minutes, you will fail and be kicked out. Only one person can be in an arena room at once. The challenges use the same 10 arenas, i.e. Greenhorn 1 is the same room as Scrapper 1.

When you enter, there is a teleport to the south. If you step in this teleporter, you will concede defeat and be sent out. When you kill the arena combatant, the blue stone to the west of the room will turn into a teleporter to the next room. You may need a lot of supplies as there is no way to restock.
Players can watch you from above, but there is an invisible barrier preventing items from being transferred to/from the arena.
If you die, there is no way to recover your items, as your corpse will be deleted if a player enters the arena to get them.

[Greenhorn] Greenhorn is the easiest of the 3. It is recommended to do this at level 15+. The entrance fee is 1,000 gp. You should not have troubles until the 9th combatant. Prepare to face Cursed Gladiator (Crypt Shambler) and Orcus the Cruel (Orc Leader); the other combatants are not worthy of mention. You can use Traps to help deal damage for low leveled characters as the combatants have low armor values.
[Rewards] You will receive a Bronze Goblet with the inscribed text Awarded to name. In addition, you may choose one of the following items:
Present containing: Piggy Bank, Surprise Bag (Blue), Bar of Chocolate, 10 Candies, Ice Cream Cone (Blue-Barian).
Backpack Containing: 100 Sniper Arrows and 100 Onyx Arrows.
[Scrapper] Recommended level: 50 (none required)
Entry fee: 5000 gp
[Rewards] You will receive a Silver Goblet with the inscribed text Awarded to name. In addition, you may choose one of the following items:
Present Containing: Baby Seal Doll, Bar of Chocolate, Ice Cream Cone (Chilly Cherry), 10 Candies.
Backpack Containing: Silver Great Fireball Rune Emblem, Silver Heavy Magic Missile Rune Emblem, 200 Power Bolts, 100 Onyx Arrows.
[Warlord] Recommended level: 120
Entry fee: 10000 gp
An Elite Knight of level 110 would typically use 260 Mana Potions and 125 Great Health Potions during the fight.
[Rewards] You will receive a Golden Goblet with the inscribed text Awarded to name. In addition, you may choose one of the following items:
Present Containing: Panda Teddy, Bar of Chocolate, Ice Cream Cone (Crispy Chocolate Chips), 10 Candies.
Backpack Containing: 100 Infernal Bolts, Mastermind Potion, Bullseye Potion, Silver Sudden Death Rune Emblem, Silver Ultimate Healing Rune Emblem.
Furthermore you will receive the achievement Warlord of Svargrond.

required_items: Completed the lower level difficulties, if any.
rewards: A choice out of 5 different rewards per difficulty, as well as a Bronze, Silver or Golden Goblet with inscribed text. The achievement Warlord of Svargrond.
