steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Recommendations] Fire protection for paladins and mages
Mana Drain Protection for mages while fighting Ferumbras Mortal Shell
Diving Equipment while fighting Ferumbras Mortal Shell

[Tips] A good strategy for "low" level teams (300-400) is to gather 10 instead of 5 players for each puzzle and miniboss. With this strategy these steps should be much safer, faster and cheaper, also lowering the risk of running out of supplies. Then, when the time comes to kill the bosses the 10 players split into 2 groups of 5.
After killing a boss, the exit teleport will send you back to the safe room before the entrance, so you don't have to worry about supplies to leave the areas as long as you reach one of the bosses.
[Important Notes] You may attempt to kill the bosses every two days (exactly 44 hours).
You may attempt to kill Ferumbras every 14 days (exactly 13 days and 20 hours).
[Method] Go to Darashia and find the scholar Mazarius in the northeastern part of town, here. When he asks you to help him stop Ferumbras from gaining godlike power, accept the quest.
[Opening the gates of hell] Mazarius wants you to bring him 30 Demonic Essences. Simply give them to him by saying: Hi - Short - Yes - Demonic Essence - Yes.

Note: After it is no longer possible to start a conversation with Mazarius if you are below level 150. That means it is impossible to gain access to the gates of hell to proceed with the quest if you do not meet the required level.
Characters that already had made access to the gates of hell prior to this are not affected by this change!

[A weapon to kill a God] Mazarius will now hand you a Teleportation Rod. Enter the portal north of him and you'll find yourself in the dungeons of the The Ruthless Seven Minions. You are supposed to use the Teleportation Rod on all seven pieces of The Godbreaker to teleport them safely to Mazarius.

Enter the portal in Mazarius' room. First you will be in a Protection Zone and there proceed through caves fighting with Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches and Demons. At the end of the cave and downstairs, there is a large room with a path to portals for each of The Ruthless Seven Minions which guard the seven pieces of The Godbreaker.

[Minions] Each way has demons to fight, a puzzle to solve, the final minion boss to defeat (with a team of up to 5 players), and then a room with a piece of The Godbreaker on which you use your Teleportation Rod.

Note: Your mission will be complete when you use the Teleportation Rod, not when you kill the boss. Thus, it's recommended that you leave the room after killing the boss quickly in order to finish the mission, and leave the loot from the boss to be taken in the Adventurers' Guild. If you linger around in the room after the boss is killed you may be teleported out of the room (if your time runs out) and you'll have to kill that boss again.
You start at the white circle.
1 - Grounds of Plague: Plagirath - The Lord of the Lice, Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Plaguesmiths, Defilers, and Disgusting Oozes.
2 - Grounds of Deceit: Zamulosh - Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Phantasms, and Nightmares.
3 - Grounds of Fire: Mazoran - Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Hellfire Fighter, Hellhounds, Furies, and Rage of Mazoran.
4 - Grounds of Destruction: Razzagorn - The Shatterer, Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Juggernauts, Destroyers, Furies, Demons, and Eruption of Destruction.
5 - Grounds of Undeath: Ragiaz - Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Undead Dragons, Blightwalkers, and Death Dragons.
6 - Grounds of Despair: Tarbaz - Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Hands of Cursed Fate, Spectres, and Guilts.
7 - Grounds of Damnation: Shulgrax - Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Dark Torturer, and Sin Devourers.
[Verminor - Plagirath's Seal] Start of by going to the Hell Hub as explained before and then follow the path to the north-western teleport as shown on the map to the right.

This seal consists in just defeating a mini boss. You will start in the north-east corner, follow the path shown in the image to the teleport south-west and you'll enter a tiny room with 5 tiles and a lever. Pull the lever and your team will be teleported to the north of a big room, where you will find The Lord of the Lice to the south.
This fight is simple, just attack it and get rid of its summons, once you kill it leave the room by the south teleport.
Note: After killing The Lord of the Lice for the first time you can use this teleport here if your team plans to fight Plagirath in the future or hunt on the second floor.
Now you will appear on another floor here, make your way to the north-west and cross the teleport here to enter the lever room.

[Fighting Plagirath] Plagirath will sometimes turn its target's appearance into a bog raider and when this spell runs out, all the characters within a great area (around the same size as an UE) will be hit for 1500 health, so the best strategy to make sure shooters don't take this hit is that they stay in the southeast or southwest corner of the room while the knight stands in the center, as far as possible so the druid can see him in the corner of his screen to heal him.

Furthermore, Disgusting Oozes will constantly spawn during the fight, and they wont disappear after the boss is defeated, so the safest method is to let the Knight block them and shoot only with Great Fireball Runes and diamond arrows for paladins, if an Ooze happens to target a shooter in the corner, the best idea would be that the paladin lure it to the knight and return to the corner.
After defeating Plagirath leave the room and use your Teleportation Rod on the part of The Godbreaker.
[Bazir - Zamulosh's Seal] Start of by going to the Hell Hub as explained above, and then follow the path to the northern teleport, here, as shown on the map to the right.

You will arrive at the southern part on the map to the left. From here you follow the blue line to the north and to the blue flag that is marked out on the picture. Here you will find a lever, that every member of the team has to pull.
The following message will appear when you pull the lever:
In another room south of this one, something just made a loud booming sound.

It will only take a few seconds for the lever to reset so it can be pulled again by another player. Once everyone has pulled the lever, head south to the exclamation mark located just south of the lever. Here you will find a teleport that will take you to the next room.

In this area you will find 8 different rooms, each one with lever that is located just outside the room's door. By pulling the levers, a monster will appear in the room and its landscape will change for a brief time to match the landscape of the monster in the opposite room. Your objective here is to bring each lonely monster to the room in front of it when its landscape matches the creature. For example, the Lonely Frazzlemaw must be lured into the room while it resembles the floor around Roshamuul, whereas the Lonely Deer must be lured into the room while it looks like a grass field with …

The 8 lonely monsters encountered are Lonely Frazzlemaw, Lonely Deer, Lonely Rotworm, Lonely Scorpion, Lonely Snake, Lonely Polar Bear, Lonely Souleater, Lonely Yielothax. All of the monsters are very weak. Have a knight on the team use exeta res and lure the monster across the hall.
(Watch the video below starting at 6:00 minutes for a demonstration of this puzzle.)

rewards: Hat Hunter Achievement, Rift Warrior Outfits, 5 Silver Tokens, Ferumbras' Teddy, 4 Folded Rift Carpets, 4 Rift Tapestries, 10 Crystal Coins. Also, the possibility to obtain Ferumbras' Hat and Mysterious Scroll from Ferumbras Mortal Shell.

[Method] Exit Edron Castle from the south and follow the path east toward Stonehome. When you cross the bridge exiting Edron, go north along the mountain until you find Avar Tar. Go up the ramp west of Avar Tar to reach the mountain pass of the Edron Wyvern Hill.
Follow the mountain pass west all the way and go down at the end of it. Do not go up as this is the Edron Wyvern Hill.

Go north until you run into a large hill. Turn west and continue until you find another hill (here). This is the Edron Dragon Lair. You may encounter a Wyvern on the way here. Orshabaal spawns on the way too, but you shouldn't encounter him.
Go down the ramp inside the mountain. You will encounter 2 Dragons here. Go north and down the hole.
Nothing is here, just go north and rope up to get to the main area.

You're now in the main area of Edron's dragon lair. Go north and be prepared to face many Dragon Hatchlings and Dragons. On the middle of the floor there is a ramp going down. Go down it when you find it.
Down the ramp you'll find a single Dragon Lord. Kill it and go down the hole.

Immediately you will find 3 Dragon Lords and 3 Dragon Lord Hatchlings. Kill them all and claim the first rewards in the chest on the south-west corner of the room. You will find a Ring of Healing, Dragon Necklace and 7 Small Diamonds. If they haven't been taken yet, you may also find another chest with 300 Gold Coins, a Steel Shield, Plate Legs, a Double Axe, a Dark Helmet and a half-decayed human Skeleton.

In order to obtain the Fire Axe you must find the pick hole on this floor. It is 2 sqm south-west of where you came from, or 3 sqm east and 5 sqm north of the quest chest (see also the image below). You may need to use Destroy Field Runes here. When you have picked open the hole, go down and use the Pile of Bones (Quest) to obtain the final reward, the Fire Axe.

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Walk to the Halls of Hope north of Thais, here.

When a Game World has been just created, the temple will be unfinished, and it must be finished by giving enough Heavy Old Tomes Heavy Old Tome to Albinius. These tomes can be obtained from Brass-Shod Chests Brass-Shod Chest, which can be found in the following locations:
The basement of the tower next to Mount Sternum (here);
A house outside the Mount Sternum Undead Cave (here);
The Valkyrie shack north of Thais (here);
On the way to the Orcs in the Ancient Temple (here);
Below the White Flower Temple (here).

They can also be looted from certain creatures such as Cyclops, various kinds of Orcs, Ghouls, Skeletons and Trolls. Hand them to Albinius by saying Temple and Yes. He will take all the tomes you have in your backpack. After handing enough tomes, Albinius will restore the temple to its former glory and you will be able to use Imbuing ShrinesImbuing Shrine.
Note1: if the temple is already rebuilt, all you have to do is give him 5 Tomes by saying Temple then Yes to be allowed to use the Imbuing Shrines.
Note2: you will only unlock the first two imbuing levels. The third is unlocked after finishing the quest.

When the temple is finished, it will contain six portals leading to six locations with eventually a boss monster to fight. These bosses must be killed to unlock the strongest Imbuing level. Furthermore these bosses drop pieces of an item with which you can tame a Stone Rhino (Mount). A character may only enter each boss room once every 20 hours.
[Bane of the Cosmic Force - Energy Portal] Energy Portal

Talk to Albinius about the "Energy Portal". He will ask for 50 Marsh Stalker Feathers. Give them to him and you will be able to enter the Energy Portal which takes you to the Replica Dungeon, here, initially filled with Iron Servant Replicas.
When you pull the left lever here a message will appear:
type=server
Similarly when you pull the right lever here a message will appear:
type=server

The Iron Servant Replicas are joined by golden and diamond ones. Killing at least 5 Golden and 5 Diamond Servant Replicas within 10 minutes will cause a lava flow and a water flow to through the system, which if you follow leads to the center of the dungeon, here, where an Energy GateEnergy Gate will appear. Enter it and you will appear here in a room with 5 Stone Tiles and a lever. Stand on the tiles with your team of 1-5 players and pull the lever, to be teleported to the boss room here.
[Lloyd Lloyd] In the boss room you will face Lloyd and four immobile cosmic energy prisms: Cosmic Energy Prism A, B, C and D. After you kill Lloyd a message will appear:
type=sound

At this moment you can kill one of the four cosmic energy prisms (from A to D). Then Lloyd will re-appear and you will have to kill him again. You will have to repeat this process until all 4 cosmic energy prisms are slain, then Lloyd can be stopped for good. Please note that there is a time limit of 10 minutes on the boss fight, after which you will be kicked from the room with a sound (MY COSMIC HARNESS MAKES ME INVINCIBLE!).

A good place to trap Lloyd is northeast of the Cosmic Energy Prism D, a wild growth rune can help to prevent him re-targeting. Another thing to note is, that it seems like he is using an attack that hits everyone who is close to someone else (animated with electricity), if you stay away from each other, you might be able to avoid this hit.

If you want to kill Lloyd a second time you can do so 20 hours after you last killed him. To do that, you will have to kill 5 Golden Servant Replicas and 5 Diamond Servant Replicas again to be able to enter the Energy Gate, even if it's already opened. From now on the slain Servants won't be counted in your quest log anymore.

The Energy Gate itself will only appear if at least one person killed the Servants within the last 10 minutes after pulling the levers. You can kill the servants at any time in order to enter the Energy Gate. For example you can kill them on a Wednesday and enter the portal on a Saturday as long as you didn't kill Lloyd in between those days, and that somebody else has activated the Energy Gate.
After killing Lloyd, use the Abandoned Imbuing Shrine found here to unlock the following Powerful Imbuements:
Powerful Cloud Fabric: reduces energy damage by 15%.
Powerful Electrify: converts 50% of physical damage to Energy damage.
Powerful Swiftness: increases walking speed by 30.
Powerful Punch: increases fist skill by 4 levels.
[Circle of the Black Sphinx - Death Portal] Death Portal

Talk to Albinius about the "Death Portal". He will ask for 50 Pelvis Bones. Give them to him and enter the portal. When you enter the Death Portal you will find yourself in the Old Masonry located here, filled with Necromancers, Renegade Knights and Vicious Squires on the upper floors, and Astral Shapers on the lower floors.

Walk south-east and go down here. In a parchment called Parchment The Ghostsilver Lantern (Book) you will read the story about Zegrath and his Ghostsilver Lantern. Walk north-east here and go down. Walk east and go up here. Use the spider web (actually the floor before it) in the north-west corner of the room and you will receive a Ghostsilver Lantern Ghostsilver Lantern. type=server
In the middle of the room you will find an Old DeskOld Desk. Use it and a message appears:
type=server.
You will receive an Old Note Old Note.
Walk south-east and use a Heap of Rubbish Heap of Rubbish, here and you will receive a Painting of a Girl Painting of a Girl with the message:
type=server
Take the picture back to the room with the Old Desk and use it with the old desk. A message will appear:

[Method] In order to gain access to the hoist, you must find the Paper and the Map within the Formorgar Mines. You do not need to carry the items with you to use it, only to open the box containing them.
[Obtaining the Map] Follow The Ice Islands Quest - Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission until you reach the Formorgar Mines.

On the first floor you will find Ice Golems, Novices of the Cult, Mammoths, Stone Golems, Gargoyles, a few Bandits and a single Hunter. From the entrance, head south and stop on the third turn west. Go west until the second turn south. Go south until you hit the wall. Go east until the second turn south. Go south and turn east when you can. Continue east all the way to a Ramp down. An alternate way to save time is through the Ice Portal in the Halls of Hope if you have met the requirements. In the first map, the blue flag is the starting point coming from the Formorgar Glacier, after entering …

On the second floor you will find Acolytes and Novices of the Cult, as well as Ice Golems. Go west from the ramp just a little until you find a Pile of Bones (Quest) on the northern side of the mine. Open this to obtain the Floor Plan of the Formorgar Mines.
Now that you have received the Map you can use the hoist to go from floor -2 to floor -3.
[Obtaining the Paper] Continuing from the Pile of Bones (Quest), go back east and up the ramp you came from.
Now, go the star mark on the first map and go down there.

This floor is the one from the second map, return to the star mark but continue to the east a little more until you reach the cross mark and go down here. On this floor you will face Enlightened, Adepts, Acolytes, Nightmares, Destroyers, a Lost Soul, Ice Golems, and Crystal Spiders, and possibly other lured creatures. From the ramp you will immediately be ambushed by 2-3 Enlightened and 1-2 Crystal Spiders. Go west until the second turn south; you will find 1-2 Nightmares and a Destroyer with a Nightmare at the southern turn. Go south until you hit a dead end; you will encounter 1-2 …
This Third map show the way starting from the cross mark. The exclamation mark is the location of the hoist, but for the moment you can only use it to go up.

This floor is more relaxed. You will face Enlightened, Adepts, Acolytes, Novices, Ice Golems, Crystal Spiders, and if followed exactly, a single Destroyer. From the ramp, go west until the second turn north. Go north and turn west when possible. Continue west until you can turn north. Go north until you find a ramp; at the end of the cave you will encounter a bunch of Crystal Spiders and Ice Golems with the single Destroyer. Go down the ramp here. Fourth map:

This is the final floor; you will encounter some Enlightened, a Nightmare and 1-2 Plaguesmiths. Go north from the ramp until you hit a dead end here. The dead end contains the Box, open it to obtain the Instructions to the Formorgar Mines Hoist. Fifth and final map:
Now that you have received the Paper, you can use the hoist to:
Go from floor 3 to 2,
Go from floor 2 to 3,
Go from floor 2 to 1,
Change the destination of the hoist on floor 2.
Note that you cannot go from floor 1 to 2 if you haven't obtained the map.

To leave the mines, backtrack to the blue flag on the fourth and fifth map and to the exclamation mark on the third, to get to the hoist (here) if you want to return through the Formorgar Glacier or to the cross mark and then to the star on the second map to quickly return to the Halls of Hope.

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Required] Rope, or equivalent
Shovel, or equivalent

The following items you will be given by NPC Rafzan. If you lose them before completing the task you will need to purchase more from him.
3 Advertisement Signs
Perfume Gatherer
Guardcatcher
Bottle with Rat Urine

[Tips] Here are some tips for frequent taskers, to be more efficient in completing these tasks.

Unless you need the money, you can purchase Perfume Gatherers from Rafzan. The slug cave has 27-28 Slugs in it at full spawn; you can do a full circuit to supply yourself for the whole month, or however many you choose. This will save a lot of time. Note that you only need to purchase for the initial supply, as you will receive another empty one each time you accept the task.
The tasks Destroy and Busy both take you to the Venore Corym Cave. Save time by doing both tasks at once.

The tasks Guards, Kill, Advertising can be done together as the quest targets are all over the surface of the swamp. However, it's a bad idea to roam the swamp randomly. The Venore Daily Tasks Quest are additional tasks designed for lower levels. The reward isn't that great by itself, but the most important thing is that they provide direction. You will be going all over the swamp anyway, you might as well do the additional tasks. On doing the 3 Venore daily tasks, you should have no problems finding enough objectives for these tasks.
Consider digging for a Leech if you go to the northern construction site. You can do this once per week.

[Method] Leave Venore from the eastern exit (go down here). Leave the building and go east a few steps to find a ladder and/or ramp. This is the central construction site (Venore Daily Tasks Quest). Go to the north-eastern platform and down the ladder. Go east to find a fancy building. On the south side of the building there is an elevator (here). Use the Pulley if the elevator is up, to bring it down. Now step on the elevator and use the pulley to go up.

Ask Rafzan if he needs help. He will offer you 6 tasks. In order to receive the tasks you must say get and then the task name. In order to report, say report and then the task name. For future references, you don't need to say "help", "tasks", "get" or "report", just the mission's keyword.
The following tasks are available:

You can repeat tasks every 20 hours. After 500 tasks you will receive the Task Manager achievement. You can do all six of the tasks of the Goblin Merchant Quest at the same time. It is highly recommended to accept all tasks you will do, to save time.
[Business Opportunities] Keyword: destroy
Reward: 1200 experience and 3 Platinum Coins
Notes: this is one of the harder tasks, involving exploration of the Corym caves.

Go to the Corym Caves, through a house north-east of Rafzan's building (here). Look for Junk Trunks (they look like Large Trunks) and use your Trunkhammer on 3 of them. They will turn into Smashed Trunks. After completion, your Trunkhammer will disappear. When done, go back to Rafzan and report about your task.
[Goblin Advertisement] Keyword: advertisement
Reward: 600 experience and 1 Platinum Coin

All around the Venore swamp are Cracked Stones. Use your advertisement signs on the stones. You can only do this once per stone in a given time. Three nearby places you can find cracked stones are here, here and here. When done, go back to Rafzan and report about your task.
[Guardian Angel - Kind Of] Keyword: guards
Reward: 600 experience and 1 Platinum Coin

You will be given a Guardcatcher which looks like a Bow. All around the swamp you will find Adventurers. Use the guardcatcher on at least three adventurers. When you use the guardcatcher, one of two things can happen: the adventurer can vanish (saying "Arrrgh! Not my knee!"), or the adventurer can become an Angry Adventurer (saying "You fiend! I will get you, servant of evil!"). When you've kneecapped three Adventurers, your guardcatcher will break (with the message "Luckily the makeshift bow breaks as you hit the last adventurer you needed and not earlier!"). Report back to Rafzan when you …
[Hungry Birds] Keyword: kill
Reward: 600 experience and 1 Platinum Coin
All around the swamp you will find Marsh Stalkers. Kill 5 of them and report back to Rafzan.
[Rattraction] Keyword: perfume
Reward: 1000 experience and 2 Platinum Coins
You need to get some odor samples. You will receive a Perfume Gatherer from Rafzan to collect the samples with.
The first odor you're looking for is special snail slime. Find the Venore Slug Cave, kill a slug, wait 10 seconds and use the perfume gatherer on it. A message will appear: type=server

The second odor you're looking for is from Black Swamp Gas, which looks like smoke, or Poison Gas colored grey. You can find these in a few places in the swamp, two such places are here and here. Use your perfume gatherer on it. A message will appear: type=server

The third odor you're looking for is a Rotworm fart. Go to any cave with Rotworms, such as here Use the perfume gatherer on the rotworm repeatedly until you receive a rotworm fart. On failure, you will receive a message: type=server, and on success: type=server. On average it will take about 3.85 attempts, but the rotworm does not vanish when you fail or succeed.

The fourth and final odor you need is that of Mouldy Cheese. Get mouldy cheese from Venore Swamp Trolls, Goblins (rare), Corym Caves and many other places (daily respawns). The mouldy cheese can be obtained before the quest.
Report back to Rafzan with the complete Perfume Gatherer (its description: It is filled with smelley goo.).

rewards: 5200 exp, 1100 gp, achievement Task Manager

quests.name: Grave Danger Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Method] Go to The Inquisition headquarters under Thais (go down here) and look for Jack Springer in a room on the second floor down. Ask him about late. You'll also need to buy a Vial of Potent Holy Water Vial of Potent Holy Water from him by asking for a trade.

This quest consists in visiting 12 graves that may have been defiled. Six of them will only need a visit and the Holy Water (Dark Cathedral, Femor Hills, Kilmaresh, Vengoth, Orclands and Folda), while others have bosses that must be fought with teams of up to 5 players. These bosses are repeatable every 20 hours. The final boss, King Zelos, can be killed with a team of up to 10 players and can also be repeated every 20 hours.

[The Grave in Edron] North of Edron, go to the cemetery on a hill then down to floors. Go past the quest door and into the vortex, where you'll find the lever and spot for 5 players. Here, you'll face Count Vlarkorth.

[Count Vlarkorth] You will find Count Vlarkorth together with 5 Soulless Minions. These summons seem to heal the boss, so it's recommended to have one of the players take them away from the boss. They do very little damage so this shouldn't be a problem.

After some time during the fight, Count Vlarkorth will become invulnerable and summon one Dark creature for each player in the room, according to their vocations: Dark Paladin, Dark Knight, Dark Sorcerer, Dark Druid and Dark Merudri. For example, if the team has two Paladins and one of each of the other vocations, you'll have to deal with 2 Dark Paladins, 1 Dark Knight, 1 Dark Sorcerer and 1 Dark Druid. These summons must be killed and their corpses (Good Remains of a Druid Good Remains of a Druid, Good Remains of a Knight Knight, Good Remains of a Paladin Paladin, Good Remains of a Sorcerer …
Note: You don't need to have all vocations for the fight, if there aren't e.g. Sorcerers in the team, Dark Sorcerers will not be summoned.

To make the fight easier, you can trap the boss using Demon Skeletons in a corner. Most of its damage come from its strong Fire Wave, if the blocker stands diagonal to it the fight is a lot safer. Repeat this process until Count Vlarkorth is defeated.
[The Grave in the Dark Cathedral] Go to the Dark Cathedral and use the Holy Water on the grave in a room to the south.
[The Grave in the Ghostlands] In the Ghostlands, go down the small Crypt and find the grave to the north. Go into the vortex to the lever room. Here, you'll face Lord Azaram.

[Lord Azaram] This fight isn't very complicated and similar to other bosses from other quests. Together with Lord Azaram you'll find Condensed Sins, which you should kill using area attacks to diminish the damage taken by the team, which is considerable (the Condensed Sins reflect death damage so avoid using SD and/or death beam on them).The team should always be mindful that the boss will sometimes apply Lesser Hex on players, reducing their healing received by approximately half.

Some time after the fight begins, Lord Azaram will become Azaram's Soul, and Tainted Soul Splinters will appear. When you kill the Tainted Soul Splinters, they will become Cleansed Soul Splinter Cleansed Soul Splinters. Lure Azaram's Soul over these to heal it. You have to do this three times to force Lord Azaram to appear again. On the first few rounds, Mass Healing and Ultimate Healing Runes can be used to speed up the process, but eventually Azaram's Soul will have its health full and you'll have to do the luring part.
Repeat this process until you finish killing the boss.
[The Grave in Cormaya] At Cormaya's graveyard, go down the hole and then into the vortex. Here, you'll face Earl Osam.

[Earl Osam] The main danger during the fight against Earl Osam is the summons, Frozen Souls. There are many of them and they deal considerable Ice Damage from a distance. In order to protect the shooters, the blocker can stay near the center of the room and the shooters next to a wall, forcing the summons to target the Knight from the other side.

After some time attacking Earl Osam (Fire Damage is recommended), the boss will teleport to the center of the room and become invulnerable Channeling Earl Osam, and 4 Magical Spheres will appear on each side of the room and start moving towards Channeling Earl Osam). You must kill them as quickly as possible before they reach the boss, for each Sphere that reaches him, Channeling Earl Osam will heal for 80,000 hitpoints. If more than one Sphere reach Channeling Earl Osam, he will most likely heal to full health. The team must be ready to change targets from one Sphere to the next quickly to …
You will need to repeat this process one or two times before Earl Osam is finally defeated.
[The Grave in the Femor Hills] On Femor Hills, go up one floor and then find the grave inside the southwestern mountain. This grave has already been defiled and there is nothing else to do here.

[The Grave on an isle NE of Ankrahmun] This is the longest Grave to sanctify. You'll have to visit the Cobra Bastion and unlock the access to the basement to sanctify the grave. Note that you don't actually have to complete the full access to the Bastion nor defeat Scarlett Etzel for the Grave Danger Quest, but it's recommended to do so due to the precious equipment she drops.

Unlocking the Cobra Bastion is very similar to unlocking the Falcon Bastion. You'll have to kill 3 minibosses, and each time you'll gain access to a new area of the Bastion. There are also some doors which you must open from only one of the sides to gain permanent access to them, so make sure to check those. You can also find several documents inside the bastion, as well as a key and other interesting things. These are covered in the Bastion's page.

Note that it used to be viable to stand in the burning walls where Gaffir and Guard Captain Quaid spawn while killing them and only receiving physical damage. On April 18, 2023 an update was released to change the player interaction with these walls, making it unbearable to stand in them for too long.
Gaffir

Start by going up the ramp on the south part of the Bastion and then up two floors. Here on the third floors go to the room to the south-east where you will find Gaffir. Defeat him to receive access to the basement.

Note: If you move Gaffir's corpse to the basin near the carpet and then step on the carpet, you'll be sent to a small room where you can obtain the Dealings of the Knightly Orders in Zao (Book) document. Beware that you will be teleported out of this room about 3 minutes after entering it, so do not consider it a safe area.
Custodian

Go back to the ground floor and then down to the basement. Follow the corridors on the west side all the way south. On the south-most room, you'll find Custodian. Defeating him will grant you access to the final area of the Bastion. On the room north of Custodian, you can find the grave you must sanctify using the Vial of Potent Holy Water.
Note: For the Grave Danger Quest, this is all you have to do, and you don't need to keep unlocking the Cobra Bastion for that. Nevertheless, the remainder of the access will be explained here.

Defeating Custodian also allows you to walk through the flames east of his room, but only once. If you go back to his room, you'll have to kill it again to leave using the "shortcut" to the east. In the corridor to the east you can also find the Cart Packed with Gold. If you want to, you can help it reach the northern end of the corridor by destroying the Clutters on its way, while keeping it alive. If you kill the Cart at the end of its destination you may loot something valuable.
Guard Captain Quaid

The third and last miniboss can be found on the fourth floor of the Bastion. Go back up, past the smoke wall and you'll find Guard Captain Quaid, which fights from distance. Kill him to proceed to the final part.
The Chess Game

After defeating the third miniboss, you'll have access to a new area on the 6th floor. Here, you must levitate up the bridge at the center of the room and then levitate down to the other side of it. Then, use the rope on the trap at the center of the room to go down. When you do that, open the doors from inside to gain permanent access to them.

In here there will be a room with a chess board. In order to proceed, you must move the pieces according to the moves described in 4 documents found in the bastion. You'll also have to put a Cheesy Figurine to replace the missing queen piece. These are the moves you have to make:

After setting the game correctly with the Cheesy Figurine in place, an energy affect will appear on screen (no damage will be taken) and a Roaring Lion will spawn. Note that everyone in the room will have the access when this happens.
[Scarlett Etzel] Go back to the first floor, where you'll be able to pass the metal wall into a small room. Here, you can enter Scarlett Etzel's room with up to 5 players.

Scarlett is initially immortal. In order to maker her vulnerable, you have to use the Galthen's Chestplate which appears on a trophy stand near the throne. When you do that, Scarlett will stop moving and become vulnerable for 8 seconds. There is a faster way to dealing damage to her, however:

Scarlett will take 7500 damage if she's attacked while the four mirrors around her are facing her, as shown below. Note that she will also use her Ultimate Poison Explosion at the same time, dealing 7500 damage to the players around. Only one player should attack her, however, since she will instantly become invulnerable and attacking Scarlett Etzel when she is not vulnerable will heal her for 5000 hitpoints. Thus, the recommended step by step is:
Throw Galthen's Chestplate to the center of the mirrors.
Rotate (use) the four mirrors so they face the center of the square where Scarlett is.
Use Galthen's Chestplate and wait 2 seconds to make sure she already stopped moving.

Zhandramon

quests.name: Grimvale Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Overview] This quest has 3 separate missions which are independent from each other. The Curse of the Full Moon can only be done during full moon nights which happen from the Server Save of the 12th to the server save of the 15th of each month, when the Grimvale Mini World Change is active.
The other missions, The Curse Spreads and An Ancient Feud, can be started at any time even if you haven't started or completed The Curse of the Full Moon yet.

[The Curse of the Full Moon] This mission starts at Grimvale and its reward is gaining access to Feroxa's lair, which will open on the 13th of every month. To reach Grimvale, travel to Edron and walk to Stonehome. To the north of Stonehome is a ferry run by Cornell. Ask him for a passage to Grimvale.

Grimvale is an island under quarantine because it contains were-sickness. Humans who exhibit the were-sickness are forbidden to leave the island, although this quarantine is not very effective because the were-sickness is not restricted to Grimvale. Werebeasts must seek Purple Nightshade Blossoms within Grimvale to have a hope of curing their illness. If you are bitten by a werebeast you will eventually change into one of them, depending on which beast you were bitten by. You cannot leave the island except by dying or teleporting. NPCs on the mainland will not react to your condition except …

Warning: Because you cannot leave as a werebeast, it's not recommended to come here unless you are well prepared. To cure yourself you can either wait for a day that doesn't experience full moons, or eat Purple Nightshade Blossoms which can be found on the 2nd floor of the dungeon.

[Purple Nightshade Blossoms] The were-sickness is curable by eating Purple Nightshade Blossoms Purple Nightshade Blossoms. These flowers are found exclusively in the Grimvale dungeon. To obtain Purple Nightshade Blossoms, go into the Grimvale dungeon by falling down the Pitfall at the north-east of the island. In this dungeon, there are 3 Blooming Purple Nightshades to harvest from:
From the start, head south and follow the cave south-east, where in the next room you will find the first flower (here).
Head west to the end of the cave and drop down the pitfall to the next floor. Walk north to find the second flower (here).
Head east and follow the path south-east to find the third flower (here).
When you harvest Purple Nightshade Blossoms you will receive the message:
type=server

However, you can only harvest these during full moons because when it is not a full moon, you will see Purple Nightshades in place of the Blooming Purple Nightshades. Attempting to harvest a non-blooming Purple Nightshade will display a server message:
type=server

Note that there's a 30-minute cooldown per location to harvest new nightshades, however you will only need blossoms during full moons because the symptoms of were-sickness are only exhibited during these days. That is, if you cannot harvest blossoms because of the world state, the NPCs will react as if you aren't sick.
After harvesting Purple Nightshade Blossoms three times, deliver them to Maeryn by saying nightshade.

[Killing Were-creatures] In order to enter Feroxa's lair, you will also need to help the citizen of Grimvale by killing 50 were-creatures. The number of creatures you have killed will be registered in your Quest Log in case you need to check.

[Obtaining the Liquid Silver Trap] Before going to Feroxa's room when its raid starts, you should also prepare some Closed Silvered Traps Closed Silvered Trap, which are necessary for the fight against the boss. A total of 20 traps will be needed for the fight (not for each player, but for the whole server). Usually, every players bring a few traps to help, since creating them can be very time consuming.

To obtain the traps, you will need to bring Maeryn a Closed Trap Closed Trap and Vial of Liquid Silver Vial of Liquid Silver. You can buy the Closed Trap at general equipment stores, even from Gladys at Grimvale, for 280 gold. Obtaining Vial of Liquid Silver is a bit more difficult. Go into the Grimvale dungeon, third floor, and use a Pick (Secret Agent tools will also work) on any Silver Vein in the mountain walls. You may not be able to obtain Vial of Liquid Silver at every try, in which case you will receive the message:
type=server

This does not mean that particular vein is empty - you could repeat the process and succeed. When you have attempted to mine a vein, you will be unable to try again for 2 minutes. Mining again before this period is up will result in the following message:
type=server
When you are successful you will see the following message and obtain a Vial of Liquid Silver that lasts for 24 hours.
type=server
Each time you successfully mine Vial of Liquid Silver, you gain a permission to use either blue or green glowing marks for various effects:
Green Strange Glowing Mark:
type=server
Character is healed by 250 Hit Points.
Blue Strangely Glowing Mark:
type=server
Character's speed is boosted by 90 for about 1 minute.
If it's not a full moon, you will be unable to mine the Silver Vein:
type=server
Note: You will complete the mission by entering Feroxa's lair once the raid begins, even if you don't fight it.

[Feroxa] After having delivered 3 Purple Nightshade Blossoms and killed 50 were-creatures, you will have access to Feroxa's lair. The lair will open when the raid starts on the 13th of every month, and it can start at any time between the Server Save and 12 hours after it.
At her first human stage you need to fight her with normal attacks, both spell and physical. When you reduce her health to about half, she will transform into her werewolf form.

In this second phase she is immune to almost everything except for Silvered Traps and Life Drain damage. When Feroxa walks on these traps, she will be damaged for 1,000 health points and the traps will vanish. The traps can be stacked and she does not heal, so it's a matter of having enough traps to bring the boss to half health. As an alternative, sorcerers and druids can summon either Gozzlers or Ghouls to deal Life Drain damage, but this process takes a lot longer.
At half health, she will change into her killable werewolf form. Now you must attack her with all your firepower.
When she reaches 0 health she will either turn into her weak human form or her gloom wolf form, both of which are quite weak and must be taken down with sheer firepower.
You will receive two sets of loot for the whole battle. Only the final form of Feroxa (Gloom Wolf) will grant you a kill count in the Bosstiary.

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Recommendations] Energy protection items
Weapons dealing Earth Damage, as most creatures are weak to earth
[Entering the Otherworld] Initially, you'll have to find one Messenger of Heaven which can be located in one of these locations:
North of Ankrahmun in the Kha'labal, here
South-west of Svargrond, here
West on the Zao Steppe, here
Note that only one of these places will be open at a time, and the location is randomly selected every 2 hours (starting after server save). A Spying Eye can be used to find out where the vortex is.

Talk with the Messenger of Heaven to accept the quest.( Hi - Strong - Yes ). Your first mission is to kill three bosses: Anomaly (Ankrahmun), Realityquake (Svargrond) and Rupture (Zao). You can do this with a team of a maximum of 5 players, in a maximum time of 15 minutes. When your time runs out, you will be teleported out of the boss room. After these three bosses are killed you can access a room with teleporters to several other bosses: Outburst, Eradicator and finally the World Devourer. After killing all the bosses you have completed the quest.

All bosses excluding the last one can be killed every 20 hours. The World Devourer can be killed every 14 days, but to do that you'll need 5 charges (i.e. you must kill at least 5 of the other bosses again). You can check your current amount of charges in your Quest Log.

In the room under the NPCs you will see a Glowing Vortex which you need to enter to reach the Otherworld, but before doing so you need to kill 10 creatures roaming around the vortex. These creatures are Sparkions, Reality Reavers, Dread Intruders and Breach Broods. After doing this for the first time you'll get permanent access to the vortex.

[Destruction Destabilizer] Your initial mission is to gather Charges that will allow you to enter further into the Otherworld. You need 5 charges from 5 different minions of the World Devourer. First, you must obtain the 3 charges from the bosses Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake, which can be killed in any order as long as the respective entrance to Otherworld is opened. Once these 3 have been killed, you'll gain access to the Eradicator and Outburst bosses through the small hub located here. After killing these two bosses and gathering all 5 charges you'll gain entrance to the World …

[Anomaly (Ankrahmun)] Enter the Otherworld through the Glowing Vortex located here and then find your way to a set of tiles next to a lever, located here. On the maps below, you begin at the Star and should go to the arrows and cross mark.

After pulling the lever you will appear on a small island with a Vortex (Purple). Entering it will assign you into one of 2 groups (1st, 3rd, 5th / 2nd, 4th). During the fight the 2 groups will periodically be teleported into another room full of strong monsters.

After going through the vortex, Chargers will continuously appear, kill them. After killing about a dozen Chargers, part of the team (one of the 2 groups) players will be sent to a different room with Overcharges in it. These players will only be allowed to stay in this room for 10 seconds, and during this period they should do as much damage to the Overcharges as possible. When you kill one, you should see this message: type=sound. The players that remained in the initial room can stay on top of Fire Bombs during this time since killing Chargers isn't necessary for now. Once the team is …
Now, go through a Vortex (Red) east of the lever you already used. You will appear on another island located here, with 5 tiles and a lever, stand on the tiles and use the lever.

You will appear on an island here, with the boss Anomaly and 4 Sparks of Destruction. During the fight Anomaly will sometimes transform to a Charged Anomaly, which is immune to all attacks. When this happens, you have to lure him over a Vortex (Red) which damages it for 6000 HP. These vortexes appear at random spots in the room, players who step on it get 100 Energy Damage. Note that the Charged Anomaly hits a lot harder than the regular Anomaly, but is also much slower. Since it re-targets often, it's best if the team stays in place while the blocker lure it to the red vortex and only the …

[Rupture (Zao)] Enter the Otherworld through the Glowing Vortex located here and then find your way to a set of tiles next to a lever here. On the maps below, you begin at the Star and should go to the arrows and cross mark.

To access the boss room you have to defeat a number of Cracklers first, which are invincible but can be weakened to Depolarized Cracklers, which are not. To achieve this 4 players must stand on vortexes which appear on random positions in the room. While standing on the vortexes, the Cracklers will transform into the Depolarized Cracklers and the team must attack them as fast as possible, without moving. If one of the players leaves a vortex or if the vortexes change locations, the team must find the new locations to weaken the Cracklers again. After killing the Depolarized Cracklers a red …

Note¹: Be careful not to step on the permanent vortex to the east where you enter the room. This is the exit and if you leave without completing the puzzle you'll have to start over. You can throw a Fire Bomb Rune on it as a sign.

Note²: While the Cracklers attack from distance, the Depolarized Cracklers fights in close range and deal more damage, so be careful when they transform as you may get surrounded by many of them. If this is about to happen and it's too dangerous for you, you can simply leave the vortex and they will transform again and keep a distance.

Now, enter the red vortex here. After pulling the levers on the island here you appear in the room with Rupture and 4 Sparks of Destruction, located here. A number of times a Damage Resonance will spawn together with 4 Sparks of Destruction. When this happens everyone must stop attacking Rupture immediately otherwise it will heal 4000 HP for each attack it receives. For this reason you shouldn't use any DoT (Damage over Time) attacks to avoid healing the boss. After killing the Damage Resonance the team can resume attacking Rupture.
After killing Rupture you can leave the room through the Vortex (Green) in the west of the room and you will appear here.
[Realityquake (Svargrond)] Foreshock:Aftershock:
Enter the Otherworld through the Glowing Vortex located here and then find your way to a vortex located here. On the maps below, you begin at the Star and should go to the arrows and cross mark.

First, position your team next to the lever and pull it to enter the puzzle area. In this room, Unstable Sparks will spawn in waves and disappear after only 8 seconds, followed by another spawn wave, and so on. Your team has to kill 10 Unstable Sparks, and to do that the team must be quick and always target the same creature.

You'll see a red message coming from the middle of the room upon successfully killing an Unstable Spark: type=sound. The usual strategy here is position the team on the west side of the room and then having the blocker stay a few squares east while the shooters quickly attack the creatures. As soon as the last Unstable Spark is killed, you should see this message: type=sound. You can now leave through the vortex north of the room.

Enter the red vortex south to find a small room where your team can again position themselves and pull a lever to the boss room. Initially, the boss Foreshock will spawn together with some Sparks of Destruction. During the fight Foreshock can transform to Aftershock, teleporting to the center of the room and summoning 4 Sparks of Destruction. The bosses switch between their forms every now and then. Knights should switch between ice/energy weapons for Foreshock and death/earth/fire for Aftershock; monks should use energy/physical for Foreshock and earth for Aftershock; mages should use …

[Eradicator] Note: You'll have to go to the teleport hub where you arrive after killing one of the bosses. You can do this either by killing one of them or by following the paths you can see here: Route:Otherworld#To the Vortex Hub.
Enter the teleporter here. You will appear in a small room here, with 5 tiles and a lever. Stand on the tiles and pull the lever to be teleported to a room a little to the west, here.

The boss Eradicator will appear together with 4 Sparks of Destruction. During your fight with Eradicator it will on occasion switch to a more vulnerable form for a few seconds. Each time this happens an additional 4 Sparks of Destruction will appear in the room (2 north, 2 south). It is advised to keep clearing them as they appear to avoid getting overwhelmed. The boss has high resistances to all damage types except Death Damage, so everybody needs to use death weapons, spells and Sudden Death Runes, and paladins should imbue their crossbows with Powerful Reap.
After killing Eradicator leave via the Vortex (Green) at the east side of the room and you will get back here.
[Outburst] Outburst:Charging Outburst:

Note: You'll have to go to the teleport hub where you arrive after killing one of the bosses. You can do this either by killing one of them or by following the paths you can see here: Route:Otherworld#To the Vortex Hub.
Enter the teleporter here. You will appear in a small room here with with 5 tiles and a lever. Stand on the tiles and pull the lever to be teleported to a room a little to the east, here.

The boss Outburst will appear together with 4 Sparks of Destruction. During the fight he can transform to Charging Outburst, which is vulnerable to Physical Damage. Knights and monks should use physical damage weapons, paladins Strong Ethereal Spear/Ethereal Spear and mages Explosion Runes. If it is not killed in 12 seconds, he will explode dealing a lot of energy damage. Lower level teams should equip Shockwave Amulets and Might Rings in case they don't manage to kill this form. After you are done, leave the room through a Vortex (Green) and you will get back here.

[Into the Heart of Destruction] Note¹: For this fight a maximum of 15 players can participate together, instead of the maximum of 5 players before. Coordination is very important for this battle to work, so before fighting the boss all members of the party should know exactly what their tasks will be and how to position in the room with the World Devourer.

Note²: This complete fight can be very long and take up to 30 minutes, so make sure your team is very well supplied with a small amount of AoE runes (300), SDs (300-400) and as many mana or health potions as you can carry. Lower level (under 400) mages may have trouble bringing enough Ultimate Mana Potions, so it's recommended to ask one of the Knights to bring carry some for you.

Note³: You'll have to go to the teleport hub where you arrive after killing one of the bosses. You can do this either by killing one of them or by following the paths you can see here: Route:Otherworld#To the Vortex Hub
Enter the vortex at the center of the room. You will appear in a small room here, with 15 tiles and a lever.

rewards: Ender of the End achievement, 5 Gold Tokens, Spying Eye, Vibrant Egg, Energetic Backpack, 200k, Mysterious Remains, Void Carpet, access to Powerful Strike, Void, Vampirism and Epiphany imbuements.

quests.name: Hero of Rathleton Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Go to the Underground Glooth Factory, walk west and go all the way down in the "pit". Find the Strange Pipe in the west and talk to him.
[A voice in the darkness] You will need a moderately leveled team. You can take as many or as few team members as you like but you are unlikely to make it far with fewer.

Exit the plant through the eastern quest door to enter Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon. To the far east there is a Magic Forcefield. To enter the forcefield, your team needs to turn on all 8 Strange Machines and enter before they reset. The Strange Machines are found on the way to the forcefield. There are 3 on the north side, 3 in the middle and 2 on the south side. A team of 2 could reasonably do this by running through a freshly cleared spawn.

When you have used all the Strange Machines, enter the portal to the far east. You will be in a small room with a teleporter to the east. You have 10 minutes to kill all the waves and the boss. Wait a while and Glooth Anemone will start spawning. There will be 5-7(?) waves of Glooth Anemones and the waves will occur even before you clear the last wave. Eventually, 4 Tentacles of the Deep Terror will spawn. They have a lot of health and will retreat at 1000-2000(?) health. You must kill them all at once. When the first one dies, there is a 10-second window before it spawns again with full …

[The plot thickens] After the Deep Terror defeat, you must enter the portal to the east of his room. You will be teleported to another large hall with another 8 Strange Machines. Before you do anything, talk with the Strange Pipe to ensure you can enter the next boss room. The deal is the same: turn the machines on and enter the teleport. The teleport is on the far west. When you enter the portal a few waves of 1 Rot Elemental, 1 Devourer and 1 Glooth Blob will spawn. Then, a single Feeble Glooth Horrors will spawn. Kill it, and it will multiply into 2 Weakened Glooth Horrors (2 total). Kill …

You do not need to kill all of the horrors at once, which is extremely deadly without a very large team, and in fact the Strange Pipe discourages that. Unfortunately heeding the NPC's advice is impractical because the 10 minute limitation is usually not long enough to execute a safer strategy. The safest strategy would be to kill the strongest first, meaning single-target combat all the way, thus:
Kill 1 Feeble Glooth Horror (2 Weakened Glooth Horrors)
Kill 1 Weakened Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 2 Glooth Horrors)
Kill 1 Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 1 Glooth Horror, 2 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 1 Glooth Horror, 1 Strong Glooth Horror, 2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 1 Glooth Horror, 1 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 1 Glooth Horror, 2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 1 Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 2 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Weakened Glooth Horror, 2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (1 Weakened Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Weakened Glooth Horror (2 Glooth Horrors)
Kill 1 Glooth Horror (1 Glooth Horror, 2 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Glooth Horror, 1 Strong Glooth Horror, 2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (1 Glooth Horror, 1 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Glooth Horror (2 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (1 Strong Glooth Horror, 2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (1 Strong Glooth Horror)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (2 Empowered Glooth Horror)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors

This strategy is the safest but also takes the longest. If your team has insufficient single-target firepower they will be kicked out after 10 minutes. Because of this the usual strategy is to just kill them all at once, so:
Kill 1 Feeble Glooth Horror (2 Weakened Glooth Horrors)
Kill 2 Weakened Glooth Horrors (4 Glooth Horrors)
Kill 4 Glooth Horrors (8 Strong Glooth Horrors)
Kill 8 Strong Glooth Horrors (16 Empowered Glooth Horrors)
Kill 16 Empowered Glooth Horrors
You could possibly mix strategies. The first one is too slow and the second one is too hard, so you could also try, for example:
Kill 1 Feeble Glooth Horror (2 Weakened Glooth Horrors)
Kill 2 Weakened Glooth Horrors (4 Glooth Horrors)
Kill 4 Glooth Horrors (8 Strong Glooth Horrors)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (7 Strong Glooth Horrors, 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors)
Kill 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors (7 Strong Glooth Horrors)
Kill 1 Strong Glooth Horror (6 Strong Glooth Horrors, 2 Empowered Glooth Horrors)

required_items: Rank of Squire in the Rathleton Quest
rewards: Bag containing a Glooth Glider Blueprint, 4 Glooth Bags, 5 Platinum Coins, a Walnut. Ability to access Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon and all areas of it; ability to kill bosses within. Ability to kill Raging Fires for 50 charm points.

quests.name: Hidden Threats Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Method] Go to the deepest floor of the Venore Corym Cave and make your way to the northwestern area. Move along the northern wall until you encounter a new passage harbouring a teleport for you to enter. Do so.

You are now inside the Corym Mines. Walk up to Corym Ratter and say hi/help/yes. Now walk through the Sealed Door to the east and enter it. Keep moving north until you find Corym Servant. Progress by saying to him hi/decreased resources/defy. He wants you to free his fellow underlings so that they can stage a riot.

Go downstairs to enter an area with Stonerefiners. Even though they are easy to outran, it's a good idea to kill them because you'll need the Rare Earth they drop later in the quest. Walk northeast and enter the fiery room to encounter a Box (Quest), here. Open it to receive a Metal File. Now go south and take the first passage to the right. There's a Box (Quest) hidden behind an Item Pile in this room, here. Open it to obtain a Rusted Key Fragment (Head) and proceed further down the passage until you can go no further. Open the Box (Quest) here as well to obtain a Rusted Key Fragment …

Use the Metal File on both fragments to obtain a Polished Key Fragment (Head) and Polished Key Fragment (Handle). Take both fragments to the big room you had to traverse on your way to the first box and use them on the Steaming Hot Lava coming out of the Crucible to obtain a Glowing Key Fragment (Head) and Glowing Key Fragment (Handle). Use one of the fragments on the other to obtain an Intermediate State. Use this unfinished key on the Anvil to obtain a Forged Glowing Key and then use that on the tile of water to obtain a Forged Key.
Rusted Key Fragment (Handle) + Metal File = Polished Key Fragment (Handle)  and
Rusted Key Fragment (Head) + Metal File = Polished Key Fragment (Head)  then
Polished Key Fragment (Handle) + Steaming Hot Lava (Bottom) = Glowing Key Fragment (Handle)  and
Polished Key Fragment (Head) + Steaming Hot Lava (Bottom) = Glowing Key Fragment (Head)  then
Glowing Key Fragment (Handle) + Glowing Key Fragment (Head) = Intermediate State  then
Intermediate State + Anvil (Small) = Forged Glowing Key  then
Forged Glowing Key + Water (Tile) = Forged Key

Important note: Stop this quest here (or at any point earlier of course) to be able to leave the teleport without facing the Cave Spider. If you leave the quest unfinished, the teleporter will take you back to the corym cave spot you entered from. You can always come back later to finish the quest

Now go back upstairs and walk around until you've used the key on all three locked Sealed Doors around the mine. If you want, you can enter the rooms and receive a Small Ruby from the first NPC you talk to in the northwestern room, a Small Emerald from the first NPC you talk to in the northeastern room, and a Small Amethyst from the first NPC you talk to in the southwestern room.
Go back to Corym Servant after doing this and he will ask you to obtain 20 piles of Rare Earth. These are easily looted from the Stonerefiners below. Deliver them and you will receive 2 Gold Nuggets.

That's the end of this quest. However, there's a surprise waiting for you once you use the exit teleport out of the mines. You will be teleported into a separate room containing three Tarantulas and the miniboss Cave Spider. It behaves like a Giant Spider, so just kill it and exit the room to officially end the quest. Be sure, you can solo kill giant spider, you have to enter teleporter solo.

rewards: 2 Gold Nuggets, 1 Small Ruby, 1 Small Emerald and 1 Small Amethyst.

quests.name: Hive Born World Change

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

If enough actions against the Hive Born are taken, its defenses may be breached and access to the inner Hive will be opened. In order to change the Hive stage, tasks of the War Against the Hive Quest must be completed. This World Change have three possible stages which change at the Server Save of the Game World:

[Stage 1] This is the default stage and the Hive will remain this way unless actions against it are taken. There are 4 different tasks which can be done, each one being worth one point. The server needs 200 total points in a single day to advance to the second stage.
Players can check the current stage by asking Guide NPCs about the hive or Orockle about status:

[Stage 2] During the second stage, the eastern part of the inner Hive becomes accessible. During this stage there are two other tasks that can be completed and are worth 2 points each. In order to advance to the next and final stage, another 200 actions are necessary. If this is not done after 3 days, the Hive will return to the first stage.

At this stage it's also possible to enter some reward rooms to obtain Gooey Masses from Insectoid Cells. Note that in order to enter the rooms you need to speak to Orockle (reward, yes) and spend 50 Favour Points of the quest (gained through completing the tasks). Orockle will use a special pheromone on you that allows you to go through the Hive Gates on all floors for 7 days.
Or if the number of actions taken is at least 200:

[Stage 3] During this stage, the Hive is completely exposed and the western side of the inner Hive is also accessible. If you have the pheromone from Orockle, you'll have access to other reward rooms with Gooey Masses as well as the room of the Insectoid Outfits Quest. The western side is also home of the Hive Born Bosses Chopper, Fleshslicer, Maw, Mindmasher, Rotspit and Shadowstalker which may drop special Dung Balls worth 10 War Exp. of the War Against the Hive Quest each. Finally, Ladybugs may also be found on the ground floor of the Hive during this stage.
This stage lasts 5 days, after which it reverts to stage 1. If at least 200 actions were taken during the final day of stage 3, it will revert to stage 2 instead.
On the last day of stage 3:

rewards: Access to the inner Hive Born, possibility to complete the Insectoid Outfits Quest and also to tame a Ladybug.

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
This world change exists at any one point in either of two main states:
The horses are confined to their stable.
The horses are on the loose.
State (1) occurs if enough players have rented horses at either one of the horse stables, and state (2) occurs otherwise.
While state (1) is active horses do not spawn outside of their stable; thus to tame a Wild Horse renting horses must be prevented.

During state (2), Horses will spawn in the wild around the Thaian Horse Station, located east of Thais. Wild Horses can be spotted each three hours starting from server save. Raids occur in groups of 0-3 horses: they may not spawn at all.
To tame a wild horse, bring plenty of Sugar Oat and use them on the wild horses. Note that regular horses cannot be tamed.

The state will revert back to (1) when enough domestic horses have been lured back into their pen. It can automatically revert back if no horses have been returned, but this would only happen after four or more days.

rewards: Ability to rent Horses (applies to entire server, even free account players). Also during the world change, War Horses may be tamed.

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Method] This quest consists of preparing 10 dishes with Jean Pierre. For every dish you will need to bring a list of ingredients and Jean Pierre will cook them into a dish, which you will receive. After finishing all dishes you will also get Jean Pierre's Cookbook I and Jean Pierre's Cookbook II. Then you can make every dish again, once a year, but you will have to bring the ingredients again.

CipSoft held a Gourmet Competition in May 2010 where players were asked to design some new recipes for Jean Pierre to cook. There were 4 winning recipes which was introduced into the game with the summer update 2010. (Be aware that some details about these winning recipes might be changed a bit when they were introduced) The winners and those dishes are as follows:
Best Starter: Coconut Shrimp Bake by Natalya Rimsky, an exotic rice dish with a touch of white and brown mushrooms.
Best Main Dish: Blackjack by Karolak, it's like a stew that looks rather awful, but it is pretty tasty and vitamin-rich.
Best Dessert: Demonic Candy Balls by Hitogedgy, delicious dreams of sweetness with some unpredictable effects for those who dare to eat them.
Best Drink: Sweet Mangonaise Elixir by Exaga, a kind of powerful magical liquid that works perfectly with rings.
With the introduction of the Monk vocation, a new dish Zaoan Sauce was added to complement the Monk's use of Fist Fighting skill.
Notes:
The first time you finish the quest you get 14 dishes, after that you can do any recipe again for a total of 28 dishes the first time.

Most items can be bought in many different towns but if you only visit these towns: Edron, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Thais, Carlin and Svargrond you will get them all (except items you can't buy) and do less traveling.
The flour can be made by harvesting some bunches of wheat with a Scythe and used with a Millstone or buy the wheat in Thais from Donald McRonald for 1gp each.

Annoying as it is, when he asks for a vial of something (e.g. milk), the container MUST be a vial, otherwise he won't take it, bottles, mugs, etc. will be rejected; to get a vial of anything, use the container with the liquid (for example, a mug of mead) on the empty vial and the liquid will be transfered. Vials can be bought filled with water in Edron for 8gp each, or oil in most other cities (Venore just to mention one) for 20gp each. Empty the vial of its contents and use it on a cask of wine/beer/mead which can be found in certain buildings all over Tibia.
Hint: You can also parcel a freshly killed creature from another character, so you only have to run from Darashia depot.
Important: Each dish can only be used once every 10 minutes.

[Starting the Quest] To start this quest, you must find Jean Pierre. He is a few steps to the west of the Blue Djinn Fortress (here) and tell him "hi, cook, recipes, apprentice, yes". He will ask you for ingredients to make a certain dish, bring them back to continue to the next dish. You can look for them as follows:
[Dish 1: Rotworm Stew] For this dish you have to bring:
2 meat (buy in e.g. Darashia)
20 potatoes (buy in e.g. Venore)
1 onion (buy in e.g. Ankrahmun)
1 Bulb of Garlic (buy in e.g. Ankrahmun)
5 ounces of flour (make it in Thais)
2 vials of beer
[Dish 2: Hydra Tongue Salad] 2 Hydra Tongues (buy in e.g. Venore)
2 Tomatoes (buy in e.g. Venore)
1 Cucumber (buy in e.g. Thais)
2 Eggs (buy in e.g. Venore)
1 Troll Green (12 respawns in here)
1 Vial of wine
[Dish 3: Roasted Dragon Wings] 1 Fresh Dead Bat (run within 5 minutes from Port Hope into Tiquanda)
3 Jalapeno Peppers (buy in e.g. Ankrahmun)
5 Brown Breads (buy in e.g. Carlin)
2 Eggs (buy in e.g. Venore)
1 Powder Herb (3 respawns near Wyda)
5 Red Mushrooms (buy in e.g. Edron)
[Dish 4: Tropical Fried Terrorbird] 1 Fresh Dead Chicken
2 Lemons (buy in e.g. Venore)
2 Oranges (buy in e.g. Venore)
2 Mangos (buy in e.g. Venore)
2 Vials of Coconut Milk (use Juice Squeezer on Coconuts while having a empty vial in the backpack, Coconut can be looted from Sibangs)

rewards: Delicious dishes, achievement Culinary Master, Jean Pierre's Cookbook I and Jean Pierre's Cookbook II

quests.name: In Service of Yalahar Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Rewards] This quest is long and requires level 80, however, the level requirement only applies to the last mission. Only the item and outfit rewards of the quest require level 80, the access to quarter Mechanisms are obtained throughout the quest. The following table summarizes what reward is obtained when.
[The Way to Yalahar] First make sure you are a member of the Explorer Society and have the rank of novice or higher, otherwise you will not be able to talk to Captain Max in Liberty Bay.

Go to Wyrdin in the centre of the Ivory Towers in Edron and talk to him about a mission. He will explain to you that a member of the Tibian Explorer Society is in Yalahar and would like his Research Notes of the unknown city. He will also tell you that Captain Max in Liberty Bay will take you to Yalahar.

Alternatively, as a free account player, head to Wyrdin's Apprentice to the west of Kazordoon and talk to him about Yalahar. You will need to pay him 250 gold for the password (whizzkid), then you can travel from Thais to Yalahar from Captain Bluebear on Thais' boat.
Once in Yalahar, find Timothy just north of depot and ask him for his research notes. He will give them to you and talk about a native friend who is in need of help.
To finish the mission, go back to Wyrdin or Wyrdin's Apprentice and talk to him about the mission. You will be rewarded 500 gold. It is not mandatory to go to Wyrdin to continue the quest.

[Searoutes around Yalahar] Finishing this mission is not mandatory either, however it is recommended as it will save you a lot of time and money. It allows you to travel from different cities to Yalahar rather than only from Liberty Bay.

Go to captain Karith in Yalahar east of Captain Cookie, and ask him for a passage. You must give Karith only five (out of 8 possible) of the items described in the Required Equipment section to prove that traveling to other cities will be worth while. It does not matter which ones you handle, the 8 destinations will be unlocked.

Having the 5 items, you must handle them to Karith naming the city from which you acquired them and answering yes to each of them. The items do not need to be handed in at once, but it saves money and time. You will now be able to travel with Karith to these cities: Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais, and Venore. Karith respects the postmen, so the fare will be 10 gp cheaper for those who completed The Postman Missions Quest.

[Mission 01: Something Rotten] First, talk to Palimuth, east of Timothy, and ask him for a mission. He will ask you to help with some sewer malfunctions. You will need either a Crowbar Crowbar or a Whacking Driller of Fate Whacking Driller of Fate. There will be 4 locations where you need to go that have been marked with an X on your map. They are not very hard to find.

Most locations can be accessed through the Sewer Grate just east of depot. One can only be accessed through the sewer grate far to the north-west, close to the Alchemist Quarter stairs (Guide Edna can mark this on your map). Then report back to Palimuth.
[Mission 02: Watching the Watchmen] You have to find all 7 guards. This is a good mission to explore the Quarters of Yalahar.

It is faster by starting on the Foreigner Quarter (south-west), although you can also start at the Magician Quarter (north-east). You need to find the guards in the walls between the Quarters and ask them for their report. They will then give you their report and you can pass through into the next quarter to find the next guard.
The guards' locations are shown on the map below (inside the Quarters and marked with blue flags):
Recommended order: Foreign > Arena > Alchemist > Cemetery > Magician > Sunken > Factory > Trade.
After having all reports from the guards, go back to Palimuth. You can leave through the Magician Quarter, which has no mechanism at the gate.

[Mission 03: Death to the Deathbringer] From here onwards you will be able to do the mission following Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). The difficulty is the same for both sides but achievements differ. You will still need to ask mission of Palimuth even if you choose to not help him, otherwise sealed doors will not open.
Doing all missions following Palimuth side will give you the achievement Follower of Palimuth.
Following Azerus (Yalahari), you will get the achievement Follower of Azerus.
If you do at least one mission from the opposite side, you will get the Turncoat achievement.
Which addon you will get for the outfit in the end is decided on Mission 09: Decision.

Palimuth will give you two notes to read (in the small room on the left) and then send you to his superior for this mission. Yalahari (Azerus) will also ask you to read two notes he gives you and request you help him with a problem in the Alchemist Quarter — he wants you to retrieve an The Alchemists' Formulas as well as kill the 3 plague bearers. Palimuth does npt like the idea of Azerus getting a hold of the formulas and asks you to burn them by using them on an oven. You will now be able to use the mechanism to the Alchemist Quarter.

During this mission, you will face Death Blobs, Mutated Humans, Mutated Rats, Acid Blobs, Slimes, Mutated Tigers and Bog Raiders. First, you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. Then, head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Note that only the player gaining the most experience from each boss will complete that part. So if you are doing this mission with a team, you will need to kill each boss several times.
Additionally, since the Summer Update 2012, the hitpoints and spell damage of the diseased bosses have been reduced (), and a shortcut to Diseased Fred was added.
Players can find Diseased Dan here, Diseased Bill here, and Diseased Fred here.

You may have to face Bog Raiders and Mutated Tigers to get the formulas. Go down the stairs north-east of Diseased Bill and Diseased Fred, then head north-west to the building where the papers are found (here). Now you have to choose whether to burn the formulas on an oven or give them to Yalahari (Azerus). If you wish to do good, there is one oven to the west of the box, so it is recommended that you burn them there if you are following that path.

[Mission 04: Good to be Kingpin] For this mission, you are asked to go to the Trade Quarter and negotiate or threaten Mr. West. Once again, you will gain access to the mechanism, although if you choose to help Palimuth you will not want to use this.
[Mission 05: Food or Fight] On this mission you are asked to find a druid by the name of Tamerin, on the Arena Quarter, here. You will get permission to use the gates mechanism.

Yalahari (Azerus) wants you to get Tamerin to breed warbeasts to help them take back control of all the Quarters. Whereas Palimuth begs for you to request that Tamerin breeds cattle for food. But Tamerin will only listen to your mission after you fulfill 2 favors for him:
First: bring him a flask of Animal Cure. It can be bought from Siflind on Nibelor

You need to have started this mission in order to buy it, as well as the Ice Islands Quest started for access to Nibelor. If you are unable to go to Nibelor, you can ask someone else who has the quest and access to get it for you, as long as they are on this current mission.
Second: kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet as proof. He is located here, at the last room going around clockwise on the first floor.
Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice:
Asking for Cattle will help Palimuth (good side)
Asking for Warbeasts will help Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).

[Mission 06: Frightening Fuel] Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now.

Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room. Kill Tormented Ghosts and use the Ghost Residue on the charm thrice — this will make 2 more Tormented Ghosts appear. At this point the Ghost Charm will then change into a Charged Ghost Charm.
When choosing the Good side: go to Palimuth, ask him about the mission, and hand in the charm.
When choosing the Bad side: go to Yalahari (Azerus), ask him about the mission, and give it back.
