quests.name: Killing in the Name of... Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] You must go to the desired NPC and say task or mission (different NPCs respond to different words - see transcripts for individual wording).

In order for a specific creature to contribute towards your total (say an individual Mammoth towards the 300), you will need be the player dealing most of the damage to it. In a party-share scenario, however, all the players that hit the creature will get one kill attributed. Summoned Creatures' damage also counts as its owner's participation. Killing summoned creatures does not count towards your kill total.
NOTES:
Once you have accepted a task, it doesn't matter at what level you finish it (i.e. you can finish the Minotaurs task at any level once you have been assigned it).

Some of these tasks can be repeated up to two times as long as you have the correct level. Even if you kill more creatures than required for a task, the counter will still reset and start at 0 if the task is repeated (the extra creatures killed will not count towards the next task). Since Update 9.2 up to three Paw and Fur tasks can be worked on at the same time.
Players of level 130 or higher will receive bonus points for completing tasks providing that they have less than 70 points already.
3 extra points for those who have 0 to 20 task points.
2 points more to those which have 21 to 40 task points.
1 extra point to players who have 41 to 70 task points.
However, even if you already had 70 points before reporting the completion of your first 130+ task, you will still receive one extra point for that task only.

The task for killing Minotaurs and the first Necromancers task are not repeatable, tasks for killing Demodras and Tiquandas Revenge can be repeated once if you fail to kill them the first time, and all other tasks can be repeated multiple or even an indefinite number of times.
Attaining the highest rank of the Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite does not lock you out from Grizzly Adams' hunting tasks. You just won't be able to receive any more task points.
You can get tasks from different NPCs and complete them together, e.g. you can work on up to 3 Grizzly Adams' tasks alongside Budrik's task without abandoning one task for another.
In order to have the right to kill bosses, you must do hunting tasks (even if you have 100 points).

Players who have reached the maximum amount of points for their level's rank will not receive more points. When they complete tasks, however, they may select any boss in or below their level range. The bosses in a lower tier may only be selected once (this is intended to receive the achievements). In addition, level 130s who have maximized their task points will not spend any boss points when choosing bosses from a lower tier. Note that only boss points received from 130+ tasks will have this effect. Boss points obtained in lower tiers will still be spent when selecting any boss.

For example, a level 130 with 100 points and at least one boss point may receive the task to kill The Old Widow without spending boss points. Once they've killed this boss one time, they will be unable to select that boss again. If the same level 130 instead accepts the task to kill The Many, one boss point would be consumed. For this reason and because players aren't bound in how many boss tasks can be active, it is recommended to request all lower tier boss tasks before asking for a 130-range boss.
[Unranked Tasks] These tasks can be received from a variety of NPCs, mostly after completing a quest for them.
There are eleven unranked tasks, which are listed below:

[Paw and Fur Society] These tasks can only be received from the head of the Paw and Fur Society, Grizzly Adams. He will give you tasks according to your level. By doing tasks you will gain points; if you have accumulated enough points, you will advance a rank. Each rank has its own unique rewards.
[Level 6-49 Tasks] There are eleven tasks in this level range, which are listed below:

[Crocodiles] This is probably the easiest task in the lowest level range and it is a good idea to do it since The Snapper can drop quite valuable items (at least for low levels) and you have a chance to loot Crocodile Boots. Bring a few potions, in case you get surrounded.
Best hunting area: Cave north of Port Hope

[Badgers] It is hard to find Badgers in large quantities together, but if you reach the level at which you can face Mammoths, you can take this task in conjunction because those two creatures are found together near Svargrond quite a bit. This task gives little experience/loot and only 1 Paw & Fur point, so it is not really recommended to do it.
Best hunting area: Mountain, south-west of Svargrond
Pair up with: Mammoth task

[Tarantulas] Like the Crocodiles task, this task is a good one and recommended to do (even repeatedly). If you are around level 25 (also depends on vocation) you can start to hunt Tarantulas in the Tiquanda/Tarantula Caves. Another good option is to hunt them along with Gargoyles and Stone Golems in the Meriana Gargoyle Cave. Fighting Hide will probably give you some nice loot, combined with the valuable Tarantula Eggs and Steel Helmets will result in good profit and experience.
Best hunting area: East of Port Hope
Tip #1: Bring food
Tip #2: Stealth ring or Invisibility can help, especially at the entrances

[Carniphilas] Carniphilas deal high damage, some of it non-blockable, and paralyze their target frequently. You should test your ability to kill them first before accepting this task. 33+ mages (especially Sorcerers) can easily solo them and make a profit. Knights may have difficulty with them but the task is still doable. Very good option if you are looking for task points but your easier options are exhausted.
The boss has a chance to drop a Sweet Smelling Bait and a Mandrake which both sell well.
Tips:
Best hunting area is definitely the Tiquanda Laboratory, east of Banuta, north-east of Port Hope.
Bring food. Carniphilas do drop Dark Mushrooms but they sell very well, so you should see them as Creature Products - collect them and sell them in bulk.

[Stone Golems] This is a good task to do if you have the level and skills, you will gain good experience and make profit with Iron Ore and other stones. To sell most of the commonly dropped creature products, you'll need to have done a high level quest (forced to sell them to other players). There are only two hunting areas that have larger quantities of them.
Best hunting area: Hrodmir Stone Golem Caves and Farmine Mines
Tip: Bring food
Pair up with: Gargoyle task

[Mammoths] This task is a good one, there are lots of Mammoths, very close to Svargrond. They give good experience and valuable loot and The Bloodtusk will probably yield some good loot as well. A task recommended to do.

rewards: Various amounts of experience and money, ability to kill boss monsters, ability to trade with Grizzly Adams, ability to travel into Tiquanda with Lorek, Holy Icon, 31 Achievements which sum up 61 achievements points (+ Herbicide, 8 points, if you use Holy Icon to do The Demon Oak Quest).

quests.name: Kilmaresh Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] There are 5 citizens of Kilmaresh that require some help. Visit each one of them to receive their mission.
[Fafnar's Wrath] Find Eshaya on the second floor of the building north of the market, here and ask about a mission.

[Investigate the Ambassador's House] Eshaya wants to investigate the Ambassador of Rathleton in Kilmaresh. Find his house on top of the city wall southeast of the city (here) and investigate the following objects of his house:
The Pile of Scrolls (Ambassador)Pile of Scrolls on the first floor;
You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
The Half Burnt ScrollHalf Burnt Scroll on the second floor;
Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
The Torn Piece of PaperTorn Piece of Paper on the second floor;
Paper scraps lie scattered on the floor. It takes some time to put them back together. But it's only a badly written poem.
Walk around the rooftop.
You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.

[Retrieve the Ring of Secret Thoughts] Return to Eshaya, which will tell you to look in his memories using a Ring of Secret Thoughts. To do that, you'll have to kill Urmahlullu the Immaculate, which can be found in a cave south of the city, here. The boss can be fought with a team of up to 5 players. Note: You do not actually have to defeat Urmahlullu to be able to complete the mission. If you happen to obtain the ring by other means, you can just turn it in and move on with the quest.

The fight against Urmahlullu is simple, but long. The boss have 5 forms, 3 of which have a lot of health. It's recommended to trap the boss near the exit teleport or on the south-west corner. You'll first have to kill Urmahlullu the Immaculate, then the Wildness of Urmahlullu, Urmahlullu the Tamed, Wisdom of Urmahlullu and finally Urmahlullu the Weakened. Note that the 4th form, Wisdom of Urmahlullu, attacks from distance and will run away from the team unless it's trapped.
All participating players will get a Ring of Secret Thoughts every time they defeat the boss until they complete this mission. The boss room can be entered again after a 20-hour cooldown.

[Obtain the Ambassador's thoughts] To get the Ambassador's thoughts, find him inside the Library and give him the ring, which he will gladly accept. In order to recover it, however, you'll need the help of a thief. Visit Moe two floors up the building north of the Market and ask if he is a thief. He will ask for 10 Sphinx Feathers. Once you have the feathers, give them to him. Moe will ask for some time to steal the ring and you must then wait 1 hour.
Note: This request from Moe appears as a separate mission called Gifts for Moe in the Quest Log.
Go back to Moe and ask again about he being a thief or about the ring, then you'll receive a Ring of Secret Thoughts (Charged).

[Extract the Memories from the ring] To analyze the memories, visit The Librarian NPC at the library for instructions on how to do so, ask him about the ring. He will tell you to buy a Flask of Hallucinogen from Faloriel, the potions NPC. Buy the Hallucinogen from him by asking for it specifically. (You can buy multiple Flasks of Hallucinogen, and give them to players that have already completed the mission so they can re-enter the brain and help you.)
Now, go to the temple of Bastesh (south building on the west side of town, here). Equip the charged ring and then use the Hallucinogen on yourself. You'll be sent to the Ambassador's Mind.

Note: Be careful that in here you'll have to fight many Earworms, which are similar to the other creatures of Kilmaresh in strength. Also note that the Ambassador's Mind has two sides and you can be sent to any one of them, apparently randomly. This means that your team might be split and will have to reunite using the Mirror Neurons.

Your task here is to loot 3 memory shards: Green Memory Shardgreen, Violet Memory Shardviolet and Blue Memory Shardblue. Each player will need one of each shard. Do not step on the energy fields, if you do that one of the shards in your backpack will vanish. After getting all shards, go to the left side of the map, where there's a Memory Enlightener (a Fire Basin). Use one of each shard on it. Now find your way back to the exit teleport (and be careful not to lose your Shards, you'll still need them).
Report back to Eshaya, who will tell you to report to The Empress. Talk to The Empress while holding the three memory shards in your backpack.

[One last favor] Given your success with the Ambassador's investigation, The Empress will ask for your help with another matter. Your mission will be to bless 5 Statues of Fafnar that the cultists have enchanted in the Catacombs, using a Sceptre of Sun and Sea which she will give you.

Since you will have to visit the Kilmaresh Catacombs, you must first find four masks, each one unlocking a set of doors of the catacombs. The instructions to find each mask can be found in the Secret Instruction documents, but you don't need those to proceed with the quest.
The Mirror Mask can be found in a coffin that is located in a dungeon under the Central Steppe. It unlocks the first door near the main entrance.
The Ivory Mask can be found in the Library after using a Small Emerald on the Ornamented Ankh there. It unlocks the doors that give access to the center from the south.
The Silver Mask from a tree on the small island west of the Central Steppe. It unlocks the doors that give access to the center from the north.
The Gryphon Mask from a Gryphon Nest on top of the Kilmaresh Mountains. It unlocks the door to the small room south of the main area.

Now, with the Sceptre in hand, go down to the catacombs and fight your way to the 5 Statue of Fafnar (Meditating) Statues of Fafnar, and use the Sceptre on each of them. The safest route is to start at the north by entering through the Sphinx/Crypt Warden cave. Locations of the 5 Statues:
After using the Sceptre on all of them, return to the Empress. Upon delivery of your final task you'll receive a Sun Medal.
[Midnight Rituals] Talk to Kallimae two floors above the building just east of the depot, here, and ask for a mission.
[The Ingredients] She needs help gathering several ingredients for magic rituals. Before gathering the ingredients, you'll need some tools:
Ritual Scissors The Ritual Scissors can be found inside a sarcophagus, here.
Bark Peeler The Bark Peeler can be found in a crate in a small house near the harbor, here.
Hand Auger The Hand Auger can be bought from any Tool Shop NPC, in Issavi (Tefrit) or other towns.
Empty Honey Glass Empty Honey Glasses must be looted from the Cultists found in the Issavi Sewers, Kilmaresh Catacombs and Kilmaresh Mountains.
Pick (Enchanted) The Pick (Enchanted) is given to you by Yonan when you ask for his list.
Once you have the tools, you're ready to start collecting the ingredients. The NPCs Yonan, Tefrit, Narsai and Shimun each have a list, which you can receive by asking them for a mission:
Yonan's List (found at the market, here).

rewards: The four parts of The Regalia of Suon, Sun and Sea achievement, three parts of the Sun Mosaic, Citizen of Issavi Outfits and permission to use the shortcuts between Issavi and the southern parts of Kilmaresh.

quests.name: Kingdom of Kormarak Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
This quest is a daily respawn. This means only one Character can get the rewards per Floor Reset.
It is recommended to do this quest after Server Save, so there is a higher chance nobody have gotten the reward before.
[Recommended equipment] Rope or equivalent, to avoid getting stuck if you go the wrong way
Great Fireball and Heavy Magic Missile Runes for lower level mages
Health and Mana Potions
[Method] Go down to the Ancient Temple, near the Thais northern entrace (here).
Go down the ladder to the north.
Follow the white line through the dungeon and climb down the ladder. You will likely encounter Rotworms, Poison Spiders and weaker Orcs.
There is a room with lots of Poison Gas but you only have to go through four of them. Cast the Antidote spell if you don't want to receive further damage and climb down.
Down this ladder there are 3 Minotaurs and a few Poison Spiders. Go north following the line. You can also go by a room with Skeletons and do the Ghoul Room Quest now.
type=look
Go up the stairs and you may have to kill three Ghouls that spawn there.

Go through the Magic Forcefield. Be prepared to face 11 Ghouls spread throughout the room and a Demon Skeleton that spawns at the far end of the room. Use some Great Fireballs to take the Ghouls out quick and kill the Demon Skeleton by shooting Heavy Magic Missiles while running away.
Open the Dead Human near the Wooden Coffin to find a Brass Armor, a Brass Helmet, a Hatchet and 13 Throwing Stars.
Category:Quests

rewards: Brass Armor, Brass Helmet, Hatchet and 13 Throwing Stars.

quests.name: Kingsday Mini World Change

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] The day is dedicated to celebrating the King. This Mini World Change takes place in Thais, and the following changes take place:
Thais will be decorated for the day (as it was for Tibia's 15th Anniversary).
Thaian NPCs will talk differently during the day.
If it's Sunday, you can enter the Tibian Prize Exhibition for free.

Raids will occur in the Knights' Guild arena every hour (approximately 2-20 minutes after the hour) in 2 waves. The second wave is triggered 2 minutes after the first one. Raid creatures will despawn 30 minutes after spawning if they are not killed.

Cursing at King Tibianus will have you sent to the Thaian Jail, where you will remain until the next raid in the Knights' Guild arena. You cannot logout in the jail, there is no way to leave before the next raid.
Greeting the king will reward players with the achievement Loyal Subject.
[Raids] It is possible to loot Party Lampions, Party Wall Tinsels and Party Wall Snakes from raiding creatures.
The King's mages have summoned some creatures from the tombs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Larvae, Scarabs, Ghouls, Mummys, Crypt Shamblers, Gargoyles.
The King's mages have summoned some goblins in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Goblins, Goblin Scavengers, Goblin Assassins, Goblin Leaders.
The King's mages have summoned some creatures from the Tiquanda jungle in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Terramites, Wasps, Centipedes, Carniphilas, Slimes.
The King's mages have summoned some dragons in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dragons, Dragon Hatchlings.
The King's mages have summoned some dragon lords in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dragon Lords, Dragon Lord Hatchlings.
The King's mages have summoned some frost dragons in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Frost Dragons, Frost Dragon Hatchlings.
The King's mages have summoned some lizards in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Low Class Lizards (Lizard Sentinels, Lizard Snakecharmers and Lizard Templars) and Wyverns.
The King's mages have summoned some minotaurs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Minotaurs, Minotaur Archers, Minotaur Mages, Minotaur Guards.

The King's mages have summoned some trolls in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Frost Trolls, Swamp Trolls, Troll Champions, Troll Legionnaires, Troll Guards, Furious Trolls, Mechanical Fighters.
The King's mages have summoned some orcs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Orcs, Orc Spearman, Orc Shamans, Orc Warriors, Orc Riders, Orc Berserkers and Orc Leaders.
The King's mages have summoned some elementals in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Earth Elementals, Energy Elementals, Fire Elementals, Water Elementals.
The King's mages have summoned some dworcs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dworc Venomsnipers, Dworc Fleshhunters and Dworc Voodoomasters.

rewards: Achievement Loyal Subject, fight against the raids in the Knights Arena.

quests.name: Kissing a Pig Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Go to Thais Farm south of the Magic Shop here.
You will see some pigs, one of them is a NPC Pig (NPC).
If you ask the pig for a kiss, it will say that you need to improve your kissing skills.
To do this, you'll need to ask some NPCs to teach you how to kiss.
Notes:

You do not need to talk with the pig between each mission. Only at the start and end do you need to speak with it. However, the responses from the pig do differ each time, so it may be interesting to do.

You can do the missions in any order. That is, if you have completed for example the banshee quest and asked the Banshee Queen for a kiss, repeating it is not required. The same goes for all other missions - you can do them in an arbitrary order. After finishing all of the missions in any order you will receive the achievement Passionate Kisser.
In addition to the note above, completing The Queen of the Banshees Quest prior to this quest's implementation should not hinder your progress of this quest.

[Saving Caramellia] Travel to Hoggle's fishing hut far north-east of Thais (here), and inquire about his unusual garden growth. He will speak of his aching back and request that you trim his grass for a meagre 5 gold reward. Take your Machete (or equivalent) and cut the Jungle Grass growing in his yard (through the sealed door). Cut to a specific tile located one square to the north and seven squares to the west of the sealed door to get an orange message stating that you "advanced in lawn mowing", and return to Hoggle about his garden being trimmed; you are given 5 Gold Coins.
Note: if Hoggle does not respond as he should, as in the transcripts below, chances are that you have completed this part already.

Now that you have become more skilled in cutting grass, you can cut the rapidly-growing grass at Femor Hills (and prevent it from growing under your feet). Head to the Femor Hills and search for the tower barred by the grass. Use your machete on the grass and climb to the top of the tower. On the top floor, talk to Caramellia and about her husband Winfred, and quote his letter True love never dies.
Optionally, return to the pig (NPC) and ask for another kiss.

[Poem for Elvith] In the elven town of Ab'Dendriel you have to go visit Elvith and ask him for a kiss. He will not reveal his secrets of kissing to the unworthy, so you have to impress him with a poem. To write poetry you need an inkwell and Blank Poetry Parchment, the latter you can buy from the NPC Olrik (the Ab'Dendriel postman, in the southernmost building). Use the inkwell on the parchments until you get a perfect poem (4 times).
type=look
Notes:

You can only write on the poetry parchment in between your two encounters with Elvith. Elvith will take your poem when you talk to him again, so be sure to make more than one poem if you wish to keep one.
In extension of the above; if you cannot use the inkwell on the parchment, you have already completed this part.
Now go back to Elvith and give him the poem.
Optionally, return to the pig and ask for another kiss.

[Ice cream for Lynda] In Thais you have to go see the NPC Lynda of the Temple. She is unwilling to discuss kissing with you, but luckily you will be able to persuade her with some venorean ice cream. Either head into Venore yourself or have someone else go to the top floor of the depot and trade with the NPC Boozer. He sells venorean ice cream. You need to deliver it to Lynda before it melts (2 minutes).
Notes:
You can have someone in Venore to send the ice cream to Thais, however it will also melt in your depot.
If you are heading into Venore yourself, finish the next mission before you go buy the ice cream.
Optionally, return to the pig (NPC) and ask for another kiss.

[Play with Zebron] Go to Venore, search for the NPC Zebron under the depot. Ask him for a Kiss and tell him that you are Worthy. He will invite you to play dice. In order for him to tell you his kissing secrets, you have to win three times in a row (winning a game doesn't cost you anything, if you lose he will take 25 gold).
Optionally, return to the pig (NPC) and ask for another kiss.

[Favour for Dwarven Ghost] Head to the Dwarf Mines and to the NPC Budrik (the north-westernmost mine). He will ask 5 Picks from you in exchange for access to the Grothmok Tunnel. The Dwarves drop picks and there are some along the Daily Respawns in the mine entrances, so it is not necessary to bring them from town.

Once you are granted access, head toward the fifth floor (4 floors below Budrik). To the south of the rope hole, there's a room (to which you just granted access). In the back of the room is the NPC A Dwarven Ghost (here). If you ask him for a kiss he responds that he will only in return of a favour (note the British spelling, saying favor does not trigger his response).

In return for his knowledge about kissing he wants that you find and burn his fake beard. Bring a firebug and head to his room in the Kazordoon Quarters, west of the Upper Barracks (here). A coal basin lies in his apartment, as well as the chest containing his beard.

Once inside, open the chest and find his beard; light the coal basin using the firebug (it burns for about 2 minutes), and use the beard on it while it is lit. If questing in groups, each player does not need to light the basin - all that is required is burning the beard.
Return to A Dwarven Ghost and tell him you have burnt his beard.
Optionally, return to the pig (NPC) and ask for another kiss.

[Kiss Toothless Tim] In the sewer of Carlin you will find the drunk NPC Toothless Tim, in the underground bar. (Use the sewers right in front of the depot, and head to the south) In order to understand what he says, you yourself must be drunk. You need to drink 3 containers of liquor (Beer, Wine, Rum or Mead; the nearby NPC Karl sells mugs of Beer for 20 gold each) and then ask Tim for a kiss. Now that you're able to understand his drunk mumbling, also his secrets about kissing are revealed to you.
Optionally, return to the pig (NPC) and ask for another kiss.
[Kiss from The Queen Of The Banshee] Notes:
If you already kissed The Queen Of The Banshee, you can skip this mission, go kiss the pig and claim your reward.
When this quest was implemented, there was a bug that allow players finish it without kissing to the Queen. The bug was fixed and this is not longer possible.

You need to have done all the seals of the Banshee Quest, so that you can get a kiss from The Queen Of The Banshee. Go to The Queen Of The Banshee, guarded by 4 banshees and a lot of other creatures, and ask her for a kiss.
Note: You need to be level 60 or higher to complete this part of the quest. If you're not, The Queen Of The Banshee will say that you're not experienced enough and not kiss you.

required_items: A Machete or A Heavy Machete
5 Picks (readily available in the Dwarf Mines, where they are required)
3 Liquid containers of Booze (Can be either Beer, Wine, Rum or Mead).
Completion of the last seal in The Queen of the Banshees Quest; see that quest page for more information (you need a …
rewards: 5 Gold Coins, Firlefanz, achievement Passionate Kisser.

quests.name: Knight Outfits Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Outfit] These outfits may be selected by any player. Only the addons are included in this quest.
[Method] You can obtain all of the items listed above before you start this quest. You are advised to collect the items before you talk to the NPC.
Collect Iron Ore either from all kind of Dwarves or specific Geo-Elementals, such as Stone Golems.
Obtain the crude iron by trading a Giant Sword to A Sweaty Cyclops in Ab'Dendriel.
Talk to Morgan in Sabrehaven and ask him about forge. He will tell you that he can forge you either a Knight's Sword or a Warrior's Sword. Tell him you want a Knight's Sword.
He will tell you to bring him 100 pieces of iron ore and one piece of crude iron. Once you bring him the items, he will give you the sword addon.
[Method] All of the items listed above may be collected before you start the mission (except the Damaged Steel Helmet). You are advised to collect these items before you visit the NPC.
Talk to Gregor and ask him about his outfit. He will tell you that you must prove your worthiness to wear such an adorned helmet.
First you must collect 100 Behemoth Fangs by looting and/or Skinning Behemoth's.
You are then sent to retrieve the helmet of Ramsay the Reckless found behind a sealed door in Banuta's final quest room, here.
Warning: If you didn't talk to Gregor first about the Ramsay the Reckless Helmet in Banuta you will not be able to open the door to get it!
You must now obtain a Flask of Warrior's Sweat by trading 4 Warrior Helmets to the Magic Shopkeeper Djinns in the Djinn Towers or looting from Undead Gladiators.
Lastly you are asked to bring Royal Steel. It can be obtained by trading a Crown Armor to A Sweaty Cyclops in Ab'Dendriel or looted from Plaguesmiths.
Once you have all of the items needed, return to Gregor and he will send you to Sam to adorn your helmet. Wait 2 hours to get your new helmet.
[Sword] After collecting all items
[Helmet] After collecting 100 Perfect Behemoth Fangs
After retrieving the Damaged Steel Helmet
After obtaining a Flask of Warrior's Sweat
After obtaining the Royal Steel
At Sam
After waiting 2 hours

rewards: Addons for the Knight Outfits & the achievement In Shining Armor.

quests.name: Koshei the Deathless Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Parts of Koshei's Amulet] First, you have to find all four broken amulet pieces:
The Piece of a Broken Amulet (Mouth) can be found under a Loose Board in the Bath of Dreams, the building west of Darashia's depot (here);
The Piece of a Broken Amulet (Hanger) is located in a Stone Coffin on the third floor underground of the Dark Pyramid, in the far northeastern part of Darama (here);
The Piece of a Broken Amulet (Nose) is buried in the sands of the Kha'labal, above the Ancient Ruins Tomb (here). Use the sand to obtain the amulet piece, don't dig for it;
The Piece of a Broken Amulet (Eye) lies hidden in a Stone Coffin some floors down in southern Drefia, in the room with the single Vampire (here).

After you have found all four pieces, go to A Sweaty Cyclops in Ab'Dendriel (here). To reach him go through the hole in the wheat field east of depot. Ask A Sweaty Cyclops about an amulet, pay him 5,000 gold and wait 24 hours. Go back and ask about the amulet again. You will receive Koshei's Ancient Amulet.
You can exit the quest here to keep the amulet, or you can continue with the quest. Note that by continuing the quest you forfeit the amulet.
[Catacombs] Note: This part will involve killing Koshei the Deathless. It is strongly recommended to have at least 2 level 40 players although higher levels should have no problems with it alone.
Go to the Darashia Deeper Catacombs, just east of Darashia (here).

You must open the staircase to go deeper. To do so, light the 2 torches (statues) to the north and east and ensure the others are turned off, before using the Ancient Sundial by the stairs. You will hear a "type=sound" sound in the south-west room. Go down the staircase that has been revealed in the coffin in that room.

Follow the cave south and turn east when you can. Descend the stairs. Go down the ladder. Use the Box to obtain 100 Gold Coins and fall down the covered pitfall at the south part of the small room. Walk all the way north and find a level 40 bramka lvl-owa. Koshei the Deathless awaits inside. Kill Koshei and use Koshei's Ancient Amulet on the Remains of Koshei quickly because his corpse will disappear after a few seconds and you'll see the the messagee "type=sound".

Koshei will only spawn if you have Koshei's Ancient Amulet. If you step outside Koshei's room he will despawn. If you fail to use the amulet on his corpse before it disappears he will immediately spawn to the north by the altar with the text "type=sound".
When you have finally slain Koshei the Deathless, go to the south and enter the western sealed door to claim your prize.

required_items: If you plan to complete the quest you will receive 5,000 gold back. Note that you will not receive this if you decide …
rewards: Koshei's Ancient Amulet or Blue Legs (also 50 Platinum Coins, but you will need to sacrifice this exact amount before you can get the reward).

quests.name: Krailos Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Method] This quest consists of a collection of several smaller side-quests. Most of them can be started inside Krailos Village, but completing all missions will require exploring the whole Krailos. After completing all of these missions you will earn the achievement The Call of the Wild. Note: In order to get this achievement you need all seven mission completed in your quest log at the same time. Since taking on Grubokk's mission deletes the one the goblins give you, you are advised to do Grubokk's one first: #Survival of the Strongest.
Required equipment:
Rope or equivalent;
Diving Equipment;
Decorated Cake;
10 pieces of Roasted Meat;
5 vials of Fruit Juice;
12 Cookies;
5 Onyx Chips;
Hoe;
Obsidian Knife.

[Skull Orchid] Find Larek in Krailos Village. Ask him for a quest and he will tell you he needs a sample of a Skull Orchid, which you'll have to collect using the Botanist's Container (Empty) he gives you. You can find one of the required flower here and here. Use the container on it to receive a Botanist's Container (Orchid) and report back to Larek.
[Ancient Map] Note: You'll need Diving Equipment to complete this mission.

Larek will now want you to find something useful in a cave system to the northwest he explored earlier. Enter the water through the beach in northwest Krailos and swim until you reach an islet. Step into the Water Channel (here) (wearing Diving Equipment) and follow the way. You will meet Sharks and Jellyfishes, as well as Water Elementals (keep your diving gear to protect from drowning damage) and finally you can use a rope to enter a room containing a Nightmare. Use the Sarcophagus (Quest) in the north-west of this room and you should receive an Ancient Map. Report back to Larek.

[Ancient Amulet] Larek will tell you he also found something when exploring the ruins you just entered, but that he lost it to a greedy bird. He wants you to retrieve this item. Walk south of the village and you should find a Dead Tree containing a Bird Nest here. Use the nest and you should find an Ancient Amulet (Quest) (You see something glittering between the eggs and pull an ancient amulet out of the bird nest.). Report back to Larek.

[Reward] As a reward for completing these missions, Larek will grant you access to the Grille that can be found in his tent. Down here there is a depot, Skill Trainers and NPC Kaya, who is a banker and a postman.

[Quenching the Thirst] Note: this quest can only be started if the salt lake north of Ghorza's tent is dried. If it's current filled, wait a few days and it will revert to the dried state. Also, use the keyword water instead of mission or quest when reporting missions.

[Catching Spirits] Ask Ghorza about water. She is located in the northern part of the Krailos Village. Agree to help, and she'll give you a Carafe of Water Binding. Equip a Helmet of the Deep and head to the underwater area in north-western Krailos, here. Once there, kill Water Elementals and use the carafe on their corpses until it's full (5 in total). Travel to the dried salt lake just a few steps north-east of Ghorza, here, and use the filled carafe on the Salt-Incrusted Floor (Purple). Repeat the process 5 more times, killing a total of 30 water elementals. Once finished, the lake will be …

It's also worth to mention that this mission is connected to Detoxifying the Water (which is next mission related to the dried salt lake you was just able to get water into... and it's advisable to do the next mission as well, before pausing (if you will need to) cause if you will stop there, then the lake will dry out, and you will need to do Catching Spirits again... just to continue the quest (Detoxifying the Water) if it happens, and you do everything again, you will be able to complete the quest, but you will not get a reward. (It might a bug but the confirmation is needed)

[Detoxifying the Water] Ghorza will thank you for your help, but also tell you that the water is poisonous as it is now. She wants you to ask Larek for instructions on how to detoxify the water so that it becomes drinkable. Go to him and ask him for water. He will instruct you to find Golden Quartzes. He says you can find these quartzes all over the steppe. They have an orange tone with a golden shade and are often half-buried in the steppe sand. Look around Krailos Village for these quartzes and use a Hoe (you can buy one from Larek) on them to receive Golden Quartz Powder (You are grinding …
[Reward] Ghorza will be very pleased and gift you a Shaggy Ogre Bag.

[Survival of the Strongest] Note: You can't have this mission and Revolt of the Goblins active at the same time. It is recommended to do this mission first - Survival of the Strongest - which is helping the Ogres first then the Goblins next in Revolt of the Goblins in order to get the achievement without having to wait until next day. Talking between Ogres and Goblins for a mission might reset the progress you had earlier for one of the sides that you talk with earlier.
[Cutting Water] Find Grubokk in the mountain range to the south. Talk to him about a quest and he will say you can help him punish the Goblin slaves if you swear never to help any goblin ever. Do so.

Grubokk will tell you to start off by sabotaging 10 Crude Water Conveyors so that the goblins will have to suffer from thirst. In the Draw Well next to Grubokk you can find a Goblin Bone Key (Key 0555), which is needed to enter the Krailos Mines (You found a key made out of a goblin bone.). Go down the hole to the left of him and follow the way to the mines. Use the Dead Goblins (Fresh Quest) and Dead Goblins (Decaying Quest) in the mines and around until you find a Heavy Stone Hammer (You found a heavy ogre hammer. This might come in handy.). There are lots of goblins near An Imprisoned …
One here
Three going up this spot here
One here
One here

Trying to sabotage the same wheel again when not enough time has passed yet will result in the message This wheel is already dented as if sabotaged.. Once you are done (That's all the wheels you needed to sabotage.), report back to Grubokk.

[Poisoning Well Water] Grubokk now wants you to poison the goblins' well water. Take your Heavy Stone Hammer and go to the big dry lake to the east of Krailos Village, located here. Use the hammer on the Crystallized Salt you'll find there to obtain a Poison Salt Crystal. If you fail, you'll see the message That was a weak blow. Try harder., but if you succeed, it will be You pound a piece of salt crystal from the solid ground. Do this on two different concentrations of crystallized salt (otherwise you'll get the message You already took all the useful crystal splinters from this one. Try …

Now climb the mountains near Grubokk and find the two Draw Wells located there (one here and the other here). Use the crystals on them to complete the mission (You dump the poison salt into the water well. and You dump the poison salt into the water well. Acrid fumes waft up. Seems your job is done here.). Report back to Grubokk.

[Flooding Tunnels] You will now need to sabotage the three Crude Treadmills in the Krailos Mines to make them flood the mines. Use the Dead Goblins (Fresh Quest) and Dead Goblins (Decaying Quest) in the mines and around until you find Large Pliers (You found a pair of ogre pliers. This might come in handy.). Use them on the mills (here, here and here) to turn them into Wooden Treadmills (You sabotaged the treadmill. The water will flood the mines speedily. Get out in time!, You sabotaged this treadmill. The water will flood the mines soon. Sabotage the remaining quickly to get out in time!, …
[Rewards] Grubokk will give you 5 Opals and 2 Flasks of Rust Remover to thank you for your help. You can visit him after 20 hours to help him again.
[Revolt of the Goblins] Note: You can't have this mission and Survival Of The Strongest active at the same time.

[Gathering Food] To start this mission, speak with Nibble in Krailos Village. He wants to start a revolt against the oppressive ogres and tells you to first bring some food to the goblins in the Krailos Mines. Take an Obsidian Knife and visit the mountain range to the south. Go up some stairs here and follow the only way several times up and down until you meet Grubokk. Take Goblin Bone Key (Key 0555) from the Draw Well (If you don't have it yet, as you can do this mission before Survival Of The Strongest). Go down the hole, and rope up here. Continue up another rope, walk west and down …
a Bug (A light snack for a goblin, but not what you are looking for.)
a Centipede (Probably tasty and full of protein, but not what you were looking for.)
a Holy Bog Frog (You found a holy bog frog.)

Use your Obsidian Knife on twenty of the frogs (while they are alive) to obtain Dead Holy Bog Frogs. There's a total of 31 (25+1+5) Greasy Stones in the area, and they turn back to their original inhabited state after 5 minutes. Unless you're fortunate enough to collect 20 in one run, you will need to wait for the stones to become inhabited to try again.

rewards: Onyx Pendant, access to the Krailos depot, ability to trade with Krailos NPCs, Ogre Chef and The Call of the Wild achievements.

quests.name: Last Creep Standing

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
This event starts on the 20th of each month (unless there is a World Quest active or about to be launched that same day) and runs until the 25th.
[Method] There will be a new round every four hours (starting from Server Save) once the event has started. Every round will be announced fifteen minutes in advance by the message type=server.
In order to participate you are required to go north of Darashia and down the stairs twice here.

This room contains Casper, two books containing event instructions, and a Zombie Dummy, Nightstalker Dummy, Pharaoh Dummy, Carniphila Dummy, Hydromancer Dummy, Lost Soul Dummy, Blightwalker Dummy and Mutated Rat Dummy. Ask Casper for a "Shape changer" and you should receive one. This is the only one he'll ever give you, so don't lose it. It is advised to bind it to a hotkey in order to save time during the challenge. Stay where you are and wait until the event starts.
When it does and you are teleported to the challenge area, use your Shapechanger. Doing this will disguise you as one of the following creatures:
a Lost Soul Lost Soul
one of the unclothed Pharaohs Thalas
a Carniphila Carniphila
a Quara Hydromancer Quara Hydromancer
a Blightwalker Blightwalker
a Mutated Rat Mutated Rat
a Zombie Zombie
a Nightstalker Nightstalker

You now have to make your way to the teleporter that is associated with the creature you are disguised as. More of the dummies which you already saw in Casper's room will indicate which teleporter belongs to which disguise.
Transforming tiles and the Paralysis inflicted on you by the several Slime Puddles in the room can slow you down. Items and Spells that increase Speed are therefore highly recommended.

Entering the right teleporter in time will transport you to a smaller room where you will have to wait a bit before the next cycle begins. Failing to do so means you can no longer participate in the current round.
Seven more cycles will follow, each granting you less time to reach the right teleporter than the previous.

Make it through all eight cycles to win this round for the entire server and be teleported into the reward room. A certain amount of the total of 30 rounds needs to be won in order for the server to win the entire event.
[Rewards] Shapeshifter Ring (from the chest located in the reward room);
Reward Box (from Casper upstairs by saying reward), which can contain some Chameleon Runes or a Time Ring.

Anyone who manages to do every disguise with the Shapechanger will also receive the Master Shapeshifter achievement during the event, and any server that wins enough rounds will get a temporary 20% increase in respawn rates.

required_items: Speed-boosting items such as Time Rings and Boots of Haste are recommended, if not essential, for lower levels.
A supply of Mana Potions to cancel the Slime Puddles' Paralysis is also recommended.
rewards: Shapeshifter Ring, Reward Box, the Master Shapeshifter achievement and a temporary 20% increase in respawn rates for the server.

quests.name: Lion's Rock Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Mission] Go to the Lion's Rock west by north-west of Darashia, near the Darashian portal to Gnomebase, here:

Start by exploring the above ground rock; climb the staircases inside and outside the mountain. On the upper floors you can find 1) Lion's Mane Flower: use to obtain a Lion's Mane Flower, and 2) a fountain; use to obtain an Ewer with Holy Water; note: you cannot take holy water from the well more than once in a short time (1 day?).
type=server
Once you have both items, make your way to the underground cave. Not far from the start you will find a Dead Explorer, use the corpse to obtain an Old Parchment (Brown). here:

[Three Trials] This floor has a series of tunnels which lead to small rooms filled with semi-weak undead monsters. You must complete 3 trials to progress, marked on the map below. It doesn't really matter in which order.
[The Lion's Strength] (Marked 1 in mini map, North West)
You will find a Slightly Feline Statue, here. Use the Cobra Tongue on this statue. The Small Pagoda will light up signifying that you have passed the trial. You will also receive a server message:
type=server
[The Lion's Tears] (Marked 2 in mini map, North East, just east of the first trial)
You will find an Ornamented Stone Pedestal, here. Pour the Ewer with Holy Water onto the Ornamented Stone Pedestal and the Small Pagoda will light up.
type=server
[The Lion's Beauty] (Marked 3 in mini map, South West)
You will find a Coal Basin, here. Burn the Lion's Mane Flower on the Coal Basin and the Small Pagoda will light up.
type=server
Completing the 3 trials will enable you to enter the Inner Sanctum, through the Mystic Flame on the west side of this floor. You can enter as many times as you like without redoing the trials.
type=server
Go through the Mystic Flame (here) to continue the quest.

[Scroll Translation] On the second floor you will face Ancient Scarabs and Roaring Lions. The floor is split into 3 parts, which are each connected by a small tunnel on the third floor. You start in the middle part. This part of the quest involves getting a Translation Scroll (marked 1 on the map), then walking by 4 areas to translate the inscriptions (marked with blue flags.)

Getting the translation scroll (marked 1 in the map): On the second floor, go west and north and down a hole here. Then walk north and go up here. Now walk north and run past a Large Amphora in the middle of the room, here. It will crumble, and along with a Translation Scroll you will receive the following message:
type=server
Now that you have the Translation Scroll, make your way to the 4 areas marked blue, the scroll will automatically activate giving you a white server message when you're in the right spot.
Hyaena Statue, here:
From the start, go to the south-east. Go down the stairs here and go up the stairs at the south end of the tunnel here. You'll be in the south-east area now.
Go to the westernmost part of this area (south and then west of the stairs). You will find a Hyaena Statue here and receive the following server message:
type=server
Carved Stone Tile (Lizard) here:
From the hyaena statue, go back north-east and go down here. Go up the stairs at the end of the tunnel here to arrive back at the middle area.
The egg inscription is to the north-east of this area, here.
type=server
Snake Ornament, here:
From the egg inscription, go to the far north-west part of the floor. Go down the stairs here and follow the tunnel north. Go up the stairs here to arrive at the north-west area.
The snake inscription is at the north side of this area, here.
type=server
Scorpion Altar, Middle area, which is on the south-west of the area, here.
type=server
These inscriptions give you the solution for the next riddle, namely the colors (red, blue, yellow, violet).

[Task] After completing the mission to grant access to the Lion's Rock Inner Sanctum and translate the scroll you can do this task to obtain a random reward. In the north-west area of the Inner Sanctum, find the southern rectangular room to the south-west, here:
In this room you will find 4 "sun" floor inscriptions as well as a rock in the center. The sun inscriptions represent gem slots.
Here you must use gems corresponding to the slot's representation. You can see the slot's representation by looking at the tile.

rewards: Achievement Lion's Den Explorer. Random item out of the following: The Lion's Heart, Gold Ingot, Yellow Gem, Red Gem, Giant Shimmering Pearl (Brown), Emerald Bangle.

quests.name: Liquid Black Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Preliminary Information] The Liquid Black Quest centers around the Deeplings world change. However, the missions are not linearly dependent. This means you can do the missions without having done any previous missions, so you can skip most of this spoiler.

The missions available, however, are dependent on the Deeplings world change. The table below lists the Deeplings stage, the missions available, and how to progress during these stages. Note that 200 points are required to progress to the next stage.
Deepling stage
Missions available
Progression method
Heart of the Sea, Soul Net
Soul Net (5 points), kill 1 Deepling guard (1 point until 100 points, then 0.1(?) point)
Coral Mine, Soul Net
Same as stage 1(?) + Coral Mine (2 points for 1 coral crate)
Deepling Guardians (+addon 1), Anchor (addon 2), Soul Net
Same as stage 1(?)Note: there's no further stage, but if 200 points are accumulated on the final day of Deepling stage 3, the world change will revert to stage 2 rather than stage 1.
[The First Visitor] Go to Gray Island. It is only accessible through harbours from Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Darashia and Edron.
Once there you may talk to Scrutinon to learn more about Quirefang. When you are ready enter the Hole south of Scrutinon.
In the -1 Floor walk north-east through the underground passage and enter the Water Vortex. Once you appear at the other side of the cave (Gray Beach entrance), use your Rope on the ground spot.
After going up, head north to reach Gray Beach. To the north-west there are a Depot and a Temple. Go to the east and enter a hole.

In this cave you will find a Chest (Quest) and a Strange Machine. Open the chest to receive Notes and Coordinates Notes and Coordinates. Use the notes and you will get the following message: "The scribblings seem to describe an underground machine. There are also some cryptic coordinates written on it.", then use the Soft Green Chair Soft Green Chair. You will then get the folowing message and be teleported to the Ivory Towers, on Edron: "At least the instructions of the portable teleporter of this machine were readable in the strange notes you found!"
Greet Spectulus and ask him about his machine and the Deeplings.
Spectulus will then explain his story about the Deepling area and offer you some special equipment to make it possible to go underwater there and give you 150 gp to travel back to the Gray Island.
[Shortcut to Fiehonja (Teleport)] From Gray Beach, follow the coast to the east and enter the south-easternmost hole (here). Head down the large staircase until the bottom.

When you reach the bottom of the stairs, follow the cave south to ramp. Follow the one-way path to the main part of Fiehonja. Walk to the north until you find a ramp going up and to the north (here or here). Go up and head further north to a staircase below with a Teleport. Enter the teleport to gain access to the Fiehonja-Gray Beach shortcut.

[Lagatos' Book of Death (for Outfit)] Note: you can do this at any time, it is not required for the progression of the quest (although you will need it to get Deepling addon 1 and 2). It is in this section only because Deepling stage 1, 2 or 3 is not required to complete this mission.

Kill Deepling Spellsinger's to loot Keys to the Drowned Library. Use these keys to open Seashell Bookcases, found in two libraries shown in the image below, for a chance to get one of the three seashell books.

Get all 3 seashell books (blue, green and yellow). This should take around 20 keys, depending on luck. Use all 3 books and go to Spectulus and ask him about the books. Once you hand the three books to him, he will give you the Deepling Outfit.

Be warned: if you buy these from players, ensure they have the blood-marks on them. Similar-looking books have been found containing text in the Fiehonja Library, the blood-marks will distinguish the addon items from the reading books.
- addon items (you need these)
- similar looking books (don't buy these)

[Heart of the Sea] Note: This mission is not required to advance to stage 2 or obtain the outfit or its addons. You may want to do this mission for the chance of obtaining a True Heart of the Sea and some other minor rewards. Otherwise, there is nothing to be gained from doing it. You can repeat this mission each time the Deeplings revert to stage 1. Keep in mind that you need to do this mission 5 times to receive any reward.

In order to please Qjell you must sacrifice Hearts of the Sea to replace the original, which was lost a long time ago. From Gray Beach go through the teleport to Fiehonja to arrive near the Qjell statue. West-southwest from the Qjell statue you will find a ramp leading below. Go down and follow the cave north-west. Along the path you will find a Strong Water Vortex which you will need to use later. For now, go south-west from the vortex through the small crevice. It will have a Warning Sign by the entrance. Follow the cave through the thin passage until you arrive at a ramp leading up. The …

The crystal mine has 3 floors with a lot of Large Red Crystals. You shouldn't need to go far from the start. You must use a Pick (or equivalent) on the Large Red Crystals. When you do so, one of these will occur:
Nothing will happen.
You gathered nothing more than some small chips of red gem.
A Deepling Guard will spawn.
Suddenly a guard jumps at you from behind!
You will obtain a Rough Red Gem.
With considerable effort you manage to knock a largely unscathed rough gem out of the rocks.

In either case you will be unable to mine for 30 seconds. Continue mining until you have obtained a Rough Red Gem. When you have mined a Rough Red Gem you will be unable to mine another until you cut and offer the one you have mined, or after a certain period of time passes (possibly 24 hours).

With the Rough Red Gem, go back the way you came and stop near the Warning Sign. There is a Strong Water Vortex nearby. Use the Rough Red Gem on the Strong Water Vortex to craft a Heart of the Sea. Now continue on your way back to the Qjell statue. Use the Heart of the Sea, from a distance, on the statue's gem slot on its head. It may take a few tries to hit the correct spot.

Repeat this mission 5 times to be eligible for a reward in the Stage 2 library. When the server contributes a combined total of 100 Hearts, a big red glowing gem will appear in the slot. No more gems can be mined until next Stage 1 when this occurs. Note again that delivering 100 offers no additional reward, and is not required to progress to the next stage—it is only there for flavor.
[Soul Net (for addon 2)] This mission contributes 5 points to the Deeplings progression.

required_items: Rope Rope (to get to Gray Beach only)
Pick Pick (for Heart of the Sea and Coral Mine missions)
Soul Net Soul Net (for Soul Net mission)
rewards: Access to deeper parts of Fiehonja including Manta Rays and Deepling Guardians, a few random items such as: True Heart of the Sea, 10 Platinum Coins, Necklace of the Deep, Deepling Backpack, Heavy Trident, Deepling Staff and others, achievements Gem Cutter, Navigational Error, Spolium Profundis and contribution to the achievements Invader of the Deep, Death Song, Depth Dwellers, Guardian Downfall; also Deepling Outfit and addons: File:Outfit_Deepling_Male_Addon_3.gifFile:Outfit_Deepling_Female_Addon_3.gif

quests.name: Loose Ends Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
There are 5 missions given (at once) during this quest. You do not need to speak to an NPC to get them, as your quest log is updated as soon as you leave Isle of Destiny.

You can do the missions in any order, just talk to the respective NPC and start their quest. Once you do so, you will earn 100 experience. After all NPCs have been talked to, the Loose Ends quest will disappear from your Quest Log.
[Ankrahmun: Meet Ahmet] Travel to Ankrahmun (north of the Depot, up one level, here) and talk to the Ahmet. From there, you will start the Steal from Thieves Quest.
[Edron: Meet Spectulus] Travel to Edron (Ivory Towers, top of the central tower) and talk to Spectulus. From there, you will start the Sea of Light Quest.
[Outlaw Camp: Meet Rottin Wood] Travel to Outlaw Camp (between Venore and Thais, here) and talk to Rottin Wood. From there, you will start the Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest.

[Thais: Meet Eclesius] Travel to Thais and head south (here) and talk to Eclesius. From there, you will start The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest. You can also reach Eclesius from the Adventurers' Guild.
[Venore: Meet Boozer] Travel to Venore (2 floors above the central depot, here) and talk to Boozer. From there, you will start The Ultimate Booze Quest.

rewards: 500 experience by talking to the NPCs. There are more rewards as you complete their quests.

quests.name: Machinery of War Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)
[Method] Go to Baxter, he is outside the Rain Castle, in Thais.
Ask him about the "Orc War", and he will tell you that there are 3 tasks you can do:
Establishing outposts
Burning war equipment
Getting war plans
[Task 1: Establish outposts] NOTE: The outpost can only be repaired once every 6~7 hours.
Buy 44 Bricklayers' Kits from Baxter. Go to the Wyvern nest in Ferngrims Gate, outside the Orc Fortress, here.

Your mission is to repair 4 outposts and 2 walls. To repair a broken Brick Wall you have to use a Bricklayers' Kits on it. It's fully repaired when an orange warning appears and the orcs spawn. Orcs will spawn in waves every 30 seconds for five minutes. During these attacks orcs can drop Orc Tusks. For the quest it does not matter if you kill the orcs or not, when you see the warning, you can just go to the next place (if nobody kills the summoned orcs, they will dissapear after 10 minutes).
This image will help you to locate the walls and outposts.
Orcs spawn at each outpost:
1 - 8 Warriors, 14 Berserkers, 9 Shamans, 4 Riders, 1 Leader, 1 Warlord
2 - 10 Warriors, 13 Berserkers, 10 Shamans, 5 Riders, 1 Leader, 1 Warlord
3 - 12 Warriors, 15 Berserkers, 9 Shamans, 6 Riders, 1 Leader, 1 Warlord
4 - 9 Warriors, 9 Berserkers, 5 Shamans, 4 Riders, 1 Leader
W North - 8 Warriors, 15 Berserkers, 7 Shamans, 5 Riders, 1 Leader, 1 Warlord
W South - 10 Warriors, 14 Berserkers, 11 Shamans, 4 Riders, 2 Leaders, 1 Warlord
[Task 2: Burning war equipment] NOTE: The Orc equipment can only be set on fire once every 6~7 hours.
For this mission you have to set the following war machines on fire:
8 Ballistaes
8 Catapults
2 Siege Towers
Buy Fire Bug for this task and go here:
Find the Ballistaes (8) and set them all on fire with the fire bug. When you are done, go to the Catapults:
Find the catapults (8) and use fire bug on them as well to set them on fire. Finally, head south of the Orc Fortress to the Siege Towers:
When you found the Siege Towers, put all the wheels (3 on each) of it on fire.
After setting all the equipment on fire, report back to Baxter and tell him you have made an achievement.
[Task 3: War plans] When you've done the other 2 missions, go to Baxter and ask him about War Plans. Go to Orc Fortress and go down 1 floor.

The plans are at the northern wall. Use them and an orange text should appear saying you should report back to Baxter. Go back to him and tell him about the 'war plans' to be awarded 1000 experience points.
When you complete this mission you need to wait some days before you can do it again:
Baxter: We already know their current plan! Come back in a few days. By then they might have changed their plans and I will have a mission for you.
You can complete the war plans part of the quest as many times as you like, independent of the repairing/burning parts.
[Ranks] To raise your rank, complete multiple achievements (NOTE: You can either complete the Task 2: Burning war equipment (once) or Task 1: Repairing the outposts (twice) to increase your rank):
Make 3 achievements to become a Henchman and get additional 2,000 experience as reward.
Make 6 achievements to become a Mercenary and get 3,000 experience for this advancement.
Make 12 achievements to become an Orc Butcher and get 5,000 experience for this advancement.

Make 20 achievements to get the highest rank - War Hero. You will get 7,000 experience for this advancement and from now you will get 2,000 (instead of 1,000) experience each time you finish an achievement.

required_items: 1 Fire Bug (but it is advisable to carry more than one, since it can explode in your hands)
rewards: 1,000 exp for each mission, 2,000 exp once you have achieved the highest rank.

quests.name: Mad Mage Room Quest

[Method] The first thing you need to do is go to the Prison in Mintwallin and talk to A Prisoner, to get the key to his room, you need to go to the barracks, south of Markwin. You then need to give 7 apples to A Prisoner to change them for the key to the quest room.

[Description] The Magic Sword Quest, also known as the Sword of Valor Quest, was the first way to acquire a Magic Sword, before the implementation of The Annihilator Quest, as well as Demon Armors, Demon Legs and a Yellow Spell Wand. It is unknown when the quest was implemented in the game but it's certain that it happened before Update 5.1 by checking old screenshots and comparing them with client sprites from older versions of the game.
The quest was located at the most southern part of Mintwallin, here.

The quest concept is quite simple but it was very difficult for players to complete it at the time. Once you got to the most southern part of Mintwallin you'd go one level up by using a ladder. Here you'd have to face some Demons (known as Daemons at the time).

Once done with killing Demons, players could move forward and go down on a hole located far west in the room. Going down they would see themselves in a corridor with lots of fire fields, and moving forward they would face themselves against an even larger number of Demons. The exact amount of Demons is uncertain.
By killing the Demons players could advance within the room and access the two reward chests in the room. Their reward was split as follows:
North chest: a Yellow Spell Wand Yellow Spell Wand, a Demon Armor Demon Armor and Demon Legs Demon Legs
South chest: a Magic Sword Magic Sword, a Demon Armor Demon Armor and Demon Legs Demon Legs

The rewards were distributed in normal chests, meaning players would open chests and find the items in them and then they would need to decide what to do next (whether they would like to split them or not, etc). Since it was a room without any sort of restrictions, players could theoretically redo the quest as many times as they wanted to, however the rewards would take weeks to reset.

[History] According to an article published on the Nightmare Knights website, Arieswar, Lightbringer and Flamehead were the first players to enter the quest room and manage to complete it, however without killing the Demons in the main room but luring them away. The reward was split as follows:
Arieswar: Magic Sword and a Demon Armor
Lightbringer: Yellow Spell Wand and Demon Legs
Flamehead: a Demon Armor and Demon Legs
Arieswar gave his armor to Lady Rebel shortly after the quest completion.

[Deprecation] With the quest deprecation the entrance was slightly changed and a monument was added to it mentioning that's where brave Minotaurs that have destroyed the Demons and their minions that haunted Mintwallin have died and their sacrifice will give Mintwallin power to restore the cave to be a part of their town.

rewards: Magic Sword, Yellow Spell Wand and two sets of Demon Armors and Demon Legs.

quests.name: Make Believe Quest

steps.text: TODO: przetłumacz i uprość kroki poniżej (tekst z TibiaWiki, po angielsku)

[Boss Difficulty System] The bosses in this quest were the first to introduce the Boss Difficulty System. It is important to note that the guide here will display the fights and mechanics of difficulty 1. Higher difficulties apply new mechanics, higher damage, more complexity, but also more rewards. The mechanics and values listed here should be without any additional modifiers from difficulty scaling.

[Access to Thalassara] Players start the quest by meeting NPC Wayland Smythers next to the temple in Venore, here. Wayland is looking for someone willing to fight enemies who have fallen from the moon, and free his mentor, Doctor Marrow, from them.

He suggests you sneak in a supply ship and head to Thalassara, and for that he will grant you access through the storehouse that loads the ship. In the storehouse, you need to disguise as a cargo crate by clicking the crate at the entrance, and follow your way to the northwest part of the room.

Keep on moving while avoiding getting caught by the guards (being in melee range). Standing in the same tile for too long makes your character sneeze, and you will get caught. There are also some grid tiles that make noise when you step on them, revealing your position to nearby guards.
Reaching the northwest area, just jump in the teleport and you will arrive in Thalassara after a short cutscene.

[Moonspawn Juggernaut] Now in Thalassara, walk to the southeast and go up some stairs to find the mayor of Salgadara village, Mayor Pocaro, here. Talk to him and he tells you that in order to help, you need to prove that you are not just another scavenger, and asks you to prove your intention by defending Salgadara when the next raid of Moonspawns happen.

The raid takes place nearby, to the east of the village, around here. Once it starts, some Moonspawn creatures will appear, and after some time Moonspawn Juggernaut will appear. Kill it and report back to the mayor (all players involved in the kill should get a quest log update message).

[Infiltrate the cult] Pocaro tells you fishermen have reported seeing suspicious, white-robed figures moving around near the fallen rock. He believes disguising as one of them and infiltrating their ranks to find out what they are up to will help you find out more on Doctor Marrow and these moon creatures.

Head to south of Thalassara, in a region called Recifar, around here. There you should be able to find Cult Initiates. Defeat one of them, and use their corpse to disguise as one of them, then enter the teleport here.

In this room you have a Gong Gong, three coloured tiles, and a book to the north. Use the gong and watch the sparkles around the book and their colour. Pay attention to the order they happen, and once the entire sequence is shown, repeat it by using the devices just north of the coloured tiles. If the sequence is done in the correct order, all players in the room receive a quest log update.
Leave the room, follow a path to southeast and enter a teleport to get inside the crater. Go south, then upstairs to get to the lever for your first boss fight.

[Mimar Haffar] Mimar Haffar is located in the middle of the lower floor, but is initially invulnerable behind an invisible defense barrier. He is locked in place, but will still target and damage players who get close.
This boss fight has two phases happening simultaneously in two floors.

[Phase 1: Charging the Cannons] Split your team so you have players on the upper floor and lower floor. The Paladin(s) or Knight(s) in the team must stay at the lower floor to handle Trapped Souls. Letting them reach the boss will result in the boss getting one charge, and each charge makes the boss stronger. The Trapped Souls walk aimlessly for a while, randomly becoming unstable (The soul is becoming unstable!), and exploding two seconds later in a small radius, dealing 25% of a character's maximum HP as Agony Damage. Eventually, they will move towards the boss. They are slow, have low HP, …
At the lower floor, there are two Energy Cannon Energy Cannons located southwest and southeast of the room, which need to be charged to their full capacity.

At the south of the room, a Holy Portal portal will transport players to the upper floor. These portals have a 30 second cooldown, so players need to calculate their movement properly. Upstairs, players need to kill Moonstone Miners and loot Moonsilver Crystals Moonsilver Crystals. These crystals can be brought down by players, or can be thrown downstairs by dropping them at the teleports located west and east.

During this process, the rooms where Moonsilver Custodians are locked up will open over time and they will move to these teleporters, trying to go downstairs to help the boss. Players can block their path by standing on their way, or using Magic Wall Runes and Wild Growth Runes, or just let them walk past if players downstairs are fine with dealing with them.

Players downstairs need to get the Moonsilver Crystals and use them on the Energy Cannons. Each used crystal powers up the cannon for 10 charges, so 10 Moonsilver Crystals are needed for each cannon. The Moonsilver Crystals disappear after a short while, so they must be used quickly.

[Phase 2: Killing the Boss] When cannons reach 100 charges, they become Energy Cannon (Charged) Charged Cannons. When both are fully charged, they fire a spell to break the defenses of the boss, letting it loose and making it vulnerable for 45 seconds. Once the time runs out, the boss teleports back to its locked position, and Phase 1 restarts. Repeat until the boss dies.

[Find Doctor Marrow] As you defeat Mimar Haffar, you and your team are granted access to the cult's base, located southwest in Thalassara, here. Enter the base, walk south, and enter the teleport to the east, then walk in the room until you find Doctor Marrow locked in a room. Talk to him and he will reveal details about moonsilver, and how he got imprisoned by the God summoned from the faith of his own cult. In order to stop bigger issues, he suggests defeating Maior Domus, a 'traitor' that holds the spiritual key to the inner sanctum.
The Maior Domus' lever room is located five floors up from the entrance of the Radiant Skyhold, here, and the way will be full of strong radiant creatures.

[Maior Domus] As the boss fight starts, players will meet Maior Domus as well as some Moonsilver Guardians in the room. The boss takes damage but heals completely all the time in this phase. This defense is indicated by the yellow shield icon, which grants it the ability to heal for around 23,000 HP for each instance of damage taken.
This fight also has two phases.

[Phase 1: Charging the Plates] The guardians have an area healing spell that is used regularly, so keeping all of them together makes them harder to kill if you lack enough damage. This is important to know, because the mechanic relies on two types of charges on the guardians. Each guardian killed will raise one of the charges by 1:
indicates charges related to the west plate. They go up when guardians die and Knights or Monks dealt most damage to them. When reaching 20 charges, the west plate will be charged.
indicates charges related to the east plate. They go up when guardians die and Paladins, Druids, or Sorcerers dealt most damage to them. When reaching 30 charges, the east plate will be charged.
When 20+ blue shield charges and 30+ fire charges are reached, the south plate will be charged.
When all plates are charged, guardians disappears and Phase 2 can start.
[Phase 2: Killing the Boss] From this moment on until the end of the fight, the boss should not be hit under its yellow shielded state, or it will heal for 23,000 HP for each hit, negating progress.

In this phase, a player needs to step on one of the charged plates to activate it. When it is activated, one random character will become Powerless for 8 seconds, represented through a magic icon. It counts down from 8 by 1 per second, healing the character for small amounts (1,000~) with each tick. Once the counter ends, the character explodes in a that can damage the boss.

Activating a plate will make Maior Domus vulnerable for 20 seconds, this vulnerability is indicated by the white 'X' icon replacing the yellow shield. Once the time runs out, the boss teleports to the middle of the room and becomes shielded again. After the boss teleports, the current plate is deactivated. Activating the plates must be repeated until all charged plates are used. Note that if at least one person remains on top of a deactivated plate, the next plate can not be activated. All players must move together from one player to another, or at least move away from the used plate before …
Characters will become stronger while staying on top of the plates, being granted a +20 skill bonus. This is represented through a red shield icon.
Once all plates are used, Phase 1 restarts. Repeat the process until the boss dies.

[Elite Fanatics] After defeating Maior Domus, leave his room and walk through some teleports located north, here. When entering the room and pulling the lever, six Elite Fanatics appear. They heal each other a lot, so they should be split from one another. When their HP is reduced to around 40%, they turn into Petrified Fanatic. The goal is to make every Petrified Fanatic stand on a Medium Richly Ornamented Floor (Lit) richly ornamented floor. The Petrified Fanatics can be pushed.
Once all Petrified Fanatics are on the special floors, an orange teleport will appear at the northern part of the room, which allows players to move towards the final boss lever room.
[Phosphorus] At the start of this first phase, Phosphorus will be invulnerable and will spawn together with several Moonsilver Protectors.

Players should clear the Protectors when possible, but focus should be the mechanics at play: in this room, there are five areas built with pedestals on it. Each area is 3x4sqm and has pedestals representing one of the vocations. Shortly after the battle starts, the boss will teleport to one of the areas. When this happens, a Rival enemy will appear in the northern part of the room. Players must lure the boss away from the pedestals it teleported to, and lure the Rival into the area containing its corresponding pedestal, killing it there. The Rivals do extra damage to characters of vocations …
The order of Rival rotation is always the same:

When the Rival is killed at the correct spot, a success message (YOU CONVERTED THE ENERGY!) will appear. If players kill a Rival outside of its intended pedestal area, a failure message (YOU FAILED TO CONVERT THE POWER!) will appear, and the boss will gain one charge, becoming stronger and taking less damage. The charges are represented by an icon with a counter.

rewards: Rewards for the quest come through the fights against its bosses. It includes:
